★ New Giant Boss Update - Spirit Lord’s Temple

A giant boss dungeon will be added to Atma’Ram: ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’


Players cannot receive “Heroes Assemble” or “Hero in Battle” buff here.

Players cannot ride on a mount in this dungeon.

This dungeon is not be affected by Item Drop Rate stat, Drop Rate Medal, Event, or other sources that increase the drop rate.

There are no limits to entry and weekly rewards can be claimed up to 10 times.

Upon clearing the dungeon, a treasure box will appear. It will be opened once any party member interacts with F1.

Weekly Reward count will go down by 1 when the item drops from the Treasure Box.

Weekly Reward Count will reset Every Wednesday at 00:00.

Weekly Reward Count will only be recovered up to 10 regardless of what remaining count the player had.
[olist]
A new item that increases the Weekly Reward Count for Spirit Lord’s Temple: ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple Weekly Reward Count Restore Tag’ will be added.
[/olist]
This item can be used by right-clicking on the item in the inventory. This item cannot be used if the player has max Weekly Reward Count (10).

 	The fusion system allows players to fuse the magic stones acquired from the Atma’Ram region.

 	Players can talk to the NPC Eris in Magmelia to fuse the magic stones.

★ Item Buff Switch Adjustments

★ Giant Boss Difficulty Improvements

 	The entry player requirement will be changed to 1-6 players for all Giant Boss dungeons (Titan’s Grotto, Plegas’s Labyrinth, The Great Steel Wall)
 	The Giant Boss dungeons ‘Plegas’s Labyrinth’ and ‘Great Steel Wall’, which were previously only available during set entry times, will now be accessible at all times.
 	With ‘Plegas’s Labyrinth’ and ‘Great Steel Wall’ now accessible at all times, the number of free daily entries will be adjusted to 5.
 	The emblem that previously appeared during Giant Boss entry hours will be removed.
 	The difficulty for giant bosses will be reduced.

 	[Plegas's Labyrinth]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Plegas's Heart and increased damage received.
 	Increased the duration of Plegas's Heart fixating on a spot.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Regenerating Plegas.
 	Increased the overload gauge gain of Regenerating Plegas.
 	Increased the overload duration of Regenerating Plegas.
 	Phase 3

 	Reduced the HP of Colossus Plegas.
 	The Ascending Current buff is applied at the start of battle.
 	Improved so that the central jump pads are permanently active.
 	Increased the duration of heart exposure after destroying the head.
 	Improved so that the ultimate is not forced to activate due to HP loss if the ultimate has been used at least once before.
 	[The Great Steel Wall]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Type-B Vargr and increased damage received.
 	Increased the groggy duration when Type-B Vargr’s legs are destroyed.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of D Drake.
 	Reduced the HP of Battle Drones and Flight Drones.
 	Increased the overload gauge gain from turret attacks upon D Drake.
 	Increased the groggy duration of D Drake.
 	Phase 3

 	Reduced the HP of Type-L Lampery GT.
 	Reduced the HP of Type-L Lampery GT Hand - L/R.
 	Reduced the HP of Battle Drones and Flight Drones.
 	Reduced the HP of turrets.
 	Increased the inactive duration of Type-L Lampery GT Hand when only 1 of Type-L Lampery GT Hand - L/R is destroyed.
 	Improved so that the hand reactivates with HP reduced when Type-L Lampery GT Hand - L/R is reactivated.
 	Increased the midair duration of Type-L Lampery GT.
 	Increased the cooldown for the Charging Rod pattern.
★ Dungeon Difficulty Improvements

 	The difficulty of Shadow Earl's Castle will be reduced.

 	Changed so that the platforms are permanently active regardless of Gargoyle states.
 	Changed so that the Gargoyle light needed to progress to the next stage is permanently active.
 	Reduced Ran’s attack power.
 	Reduced the damage of Ran’s slash and charge attack.
 	Reduced the damage of Severed Severed Shadow Aren’s slash, charge, and sword aura attack.
 	Changed so that the pattern is canceled if a certain amount of damage is dealt when Ran or Aren is charging for an attack.
★ Master Class Portrait Update

 	Upon Master Class advancement, the corresponding Master Class portrait will be added to the Custom List.
 	Upon Master Class advancement, the portrait will automatically update to match the current class.
 	Master Class portrait settings apply only to your own character's portrait.

 	The 3rd Job portrait image will continue to be displayed as before in party UI, result screens, and similar displays.
★ Bank UI Improvements

 	The Personal Bank UI will be changed.

 	Tooltips will now appear when hovering over membership tiers, providing information about bank access.
 	When clicking the character selection button, a UI list displaying the current character owned will appear. Players can now click or search nicknames to quickly and easily select a character.
 	The Shared Bank UI will be changed.

 	Tooltips will now appear when hovering over tiers, providing information about bank access.
 	The [Shared] tab can now be switched using the mouse wheel.
 	When [Depositing] or [Withdrawing] ED, players can now adjust the amount using preset buttons for 1 million, 10 million, 100 million, 1 billion, max, and reset.
★ Character

 	Improved Sweet Dream Hair and Sweet Dream Teddy/Bunny Hoodie to be dyeable.
 	Fixed a bug where attacks from summons did not provide MP and Awakening Gauge when the player was not a party leader under certain circumstances

 	[Immortal]

 	Fixed a bug where character would move to an unintended location when in air during Dash + ZZ cast.
 	[Aisha]

 	Fixed a bug where Schoolwear Designer Heels had an unintended appearance.
 	Fixed a bug where wrists had unintended appearances if Star Academy Top Piece was equipped along with other set costume gloves.
 	[Rena]

 	Fixed a bug where Hair would be shown through the top of veil when equipped with Abyssal Presence Another Hair.
 	[Grand Archer]

 	Fixed a bug where the MP return increase from command/active skill hit from Vibe Shot Passive did not work as intended.
 	[Eve]

 	[Code: Esencia]

 	Fixed a bug where the Queen’s Dignity Cooldown Acceleration effect was not applied when [Mod] Illusion Stinger: Electron Dive is used under certain circumstances.
 	[Code: Sariel]

 	Fixed a bug where Overload Cooldown Acceleration effect was not applied when [Mod] Illusion Stinger: Lightning Spear or [Mod] Dimension Link – Guardian: Breaker is used under certain circumstances.
 	[Chung]

 	Fixed a bug where the character had an unintended appearance when Lord Chesterfield Bottom Piece is equipped with other set costume shoes.
 	Fixed a bug where the string in the back had an unintended appearance when Abyssal Presence Top Piece is equipped.
 	[Ara]

 	Fixed a bug where the character had an unintended appearance when Winter Polar Hair is equipped.
 	[Elesis]

 	Fixed a bug where the hair had an unintended appearance in the Hair Shop UI when Aurora Mustika Hair is equipped.
 	[Add]

 	Fixed a bug where the character had an unintended appearance for certain motions when equipped with Police Bottom Piece.
 	Fixed a bug where the character had an unintended appearance when equipped with Japan 2015 Creator Award Darkness Assassin Bottom Piece.
 	[Lu/Ciel]

 	Fixed a bug where Lu’s earring appearance was not visible if Ciel equipped an accessory that covers the face.
 	Fixed a bug where the string in the back had an unintended appearance when Ciel was equipped with Abyssal Presence Top Piece.
 	[Dread Lord]

 	Fixed a bug where Shackling Chain debuff had an unintended icon.
 	[Ain]

 	Fixed a bug where the character had an unintended appearance when equipped with Aqua Festa Gloves.
 	Fixed a bug where the string in the back had an unintended appearance when equipped with Abyssal Presence Top Piece.
 	[Erbluhen Emotion]

 	Improved Fire of Brave buff icon from Blatt Blume and Shining Presence buff icon from Alchimie Eid to be more visually differentiated with ease.
 	[Lofty: Wanderer]

 	Fixed a bug where the character had an unintended ankle appearance in base class idle motion when equipped with Elrios Detective Academy Shoes.
 	[Apostasia]

 	Fixed a bug where the character had an unintended ankle appearance in base class idle motion when equipped with Elrios Detective Academy Shoes.
 	[Herrscher]

 	Fixed a bug where the character had an unintended ankle appearance in base class idle motion when equipped with Elrios Detective Academy Shoes.
 	[Laby]

 	Fixed a bug where the shadow effect had an unintended appearance when equipped with Evening Valentine Bottom Piece.
 	Fixed a bug where the character had an unintended appearance when bending the knee when equipped with Blooming Youth Costume Suit.
 	[Sparky Child]

 	Fixed a bug where the Super Laby Bomb had an unintended effect if it is used at a bending terrain.
 	[Rusty Child]

 	Fixed a bug where the awakening charge speed effect from Like This? Passive did not apply as intended under certain circumstances.
 	[Noah]

 	[Silent Shadow]

 	Fixed a bug where the awakening charge speed effect from Ocean Fog did not apply as intended under certain circumstances.
★ Item

 	Exascale Character Change Tickets (Top Piece, Bottom Piece, Gloves, Shoes) are now available.

 	[Armor Character Change] can be accessed through Magmelia NPC Vasili or Camp: Steel Wall NPC Haivan.
 	Fixed a bug where players could go through the wall to go down from the top in the Guild Lobby: Rainy City.
 	Fixed a bug where the Little Dancing Spirit would not dance if players used “Ghost Dance!” Idle motion with Little Dancing Spirit equipped.
 	Fixed a bug where certain pop-up message appeared numerous times upon purchasing personal/shared bank membership in Item Mall.
 	Elsword~Lithia Elite Tailor Costume will be available in the Re-Order Shop at 3,190 KC.
★ ETC

 	Added a regional map for Spirit Falls and Charming Geyser.
 	Changed the popup design shown when clicking the “Receive Buff” button from NPCs in the Hot Springs, Camp, and Magmelia.
 	Fixed a bug where the focus moved to in-game chat while using the Chat UI under certain circumstances.
 	Fixed a bug where the cube open pop-up would appear when a character attempted to open an exclusive cube for another character.
 	Fixed a bug where the awakening charge speed upon attack/attacked effect did not apply as intended for Guild Skill: Unleash Anger.
 	Fixed a bug where the Title Information UI would overlap if Tab function is used in Title UI.
 	Fixed a tooltip of Armor Modification Effect: Skill Cooldown stat.

 	Before: Skill Cooldown Decrease -n% / Skill Cooldown Decrease +n%
 	After: Skill Cooldown +n% / Skill Cooldown -n%
 	Fixed a bug where certain Seal skill effects could be seen even when players deactivated “Other Character Skill Effects” in options.
 	Fixed a bug where equipment icon had an unintended appearance when opening Exascale Circuit UI for Exascale Armor stored in Bank or Guild Storage.
 	Fixed a bug where certain NPCs had unintended quotes when using Armor Character Change menu.

★ Doom Aporia Raid Improvement

[Cornerstone of Prophecy]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Type-E Echidna and increased damage received.
 	Reduced the HP of the two types of Cores and increased damage received.
 	Changed the number of Hyperactive Skill needed to stop Type-E Echidna from charging from 3 to 2.
 	Reduced the damage needed to stop Type-E Echidna from charging.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 2 times.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic does not display charging patterns.
 	Core death happens faster.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Barkat and increased damage received.
 	Reduced the number of Discharge to activate the Elevator Console.
 	Death Zone pattern debuffs are more visible.
 	Fixating Dark Hands pattern targets 3 sets of 2 players → 3 sets of 1 player
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 2 times.
[Nightmare Reset Room]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Bifron and increased damage received.
 	Increased the size of Illusory Area created with the Dungeon Function Key.
 	Adjusted so that the max number of souls for Match the Number of Souls Pattern is set to 4.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 3 times in Difficulty Stage 2 and 3.
 	Reduced the HP of Specter in Difficulty Stage 1.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Specter Swarm and increased damage received.
 	A marker will be placed so that players can tell which Illusory Zone they are in.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 3 times, 1 for each pattern.
 	Adjusted the timing of forced teleport after HP Threshold Mechanic has been completed.
 	Players can now press the dungeon function key to change the color of magic circles during the Find the Non-matching Furniture pattern in Illusory Zones. If all answers are marked with F1, the pattern will immediately be completed.
 	Improved so that each zone has 1 wrong furniture placement in the Find the Non-matching Furniture pattern in Illusory Zones.
[Queen’s Throne Hall]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Tarith and increased damage received.
 	Changed the speed of swapping sides when Tarith/Apollyon moves.
 	Changed so that Apollyon does not have collision.
 	Changed so that the player kidnapped by Apollyon at the start of Portal pattern will be immune to damage from other forms of damage for a moment.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Tarith and increased damage received.
 	Changed the speed of swapping sides when Tarith/Type-Q Steel Queen moves.
 	Changed so that Type-Q Steel Queen does not have collision.
 	Changed so that marks do not explode before shackling, and shackling happens at the same time for Tarith’s Mark pattern.
 	Changed so that Tarith’s Light Pillar Summon attack is removed at the start of HP Threshold Mechanic.
 	Changed so that deaths during the Sepiroth’s Spear HP Threshold Mechanic from both Tarith and Type-Q Queen no longer wipes the party, but causes no groggy.
 	Extended the delay on rifle firing for the Rifle pattern.
 	Changed so that targets of the rifle are smaller during the Rifle pattern.

[Wilting Tower: Flight]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Undead Dragon Jabberwock and increased damage received.
 	Reduced the number of interactions needed with the lightningrod to complete the Final Attack pattern.
 	Extended the time available to interact with the lightningrod during the Final Attack pattern.
 	Improved so that 2 failures in interacting with lightningrod are needed to wipe in the Final Attack pattern.
 	Improved so that players will receive mana bombs with the same ion for the Final Attack pattern.
 	Improved so that ions will be temporarily disabled after the transition in positions after the first Final Attack.
 	Extended the wait time after Energy Ball has been released.
 	Changed so that Energy Ball will be summoned from a fixed spot instead of dropping from the air.
 	Removed 2 types of ions from the Energy Ball pattern.
 	Changed so that all players alive will receive mana bomb in the Energy Charging pattern.
 	Changed so that all mana bombs during the Energy Charging pattern will be the opposite ion of the player’s ion.
 	Changed so that the party will only wipe if 2 or more lightningrods have not been interacted with in the Energy Charging pattern.
 	Undead Dragon Jabberwock will only go into groggy if all lightningrods have been interacted with.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Opinionated Barkat and increased damage received.
 	Death Zone pattern debuffs are more visible.
 	Reduced the number of Magic Circles in the Magic Circle pattern. Magic Circle placement will also be adjusted to reflect the changes.
 	Fixed so that upon entering the wrong number during the Prophecy pattern, only the player in the wrong slot will receive damage. Party will only wipe when 2 or more wrong entries have been made.
[Wilting Tower: Fall]

 	Reduced the HP of Energy Charging Device.
 	Reduced the HP of Echoes of Doom and increased damage received.
 	Changed that the drone will only deactivate when it is attacked 5 times.
 	Reduced the time for the drone to be activated again.
 	Changed so that character size is reduced during the Tornado pattern.
 	Changed so that the Energy Bubble from 5 stacks of debuff will not cause the orb to grow bigger during the Energy Discharge pattern.
 	Extended the wait time between the lasers in Scraps pattern and increased the hitbox of lasers.
 	Removed the number of symbols to match during Symbol pattern.
 	Reduced the number of lightning during Symbol pattern and increased the time between the lightning attacks.
 	Increased the groggy duration during berserk.
★ Serpentium Raid Improvement

 	Difficulty Stages will be adjusted for Serpentium Raid: Serpentium Raid: Serpentium Tower and Orchestra Hall.

[Serpentium Tower]

 	Increased the stacks needed to activate Internal Annihilation Mode from 20 to 30.
 	Reduced the damage on Security System Core needed to cool the Overloaded conduit.
 	Changed so that explosion only occurs when 3 or more charging energy have been absorbed during Core Charging pattern.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Defense System.
 	Increased the damage received increase effect when energy orb hits the Defense System.
 	Increased the stacks needed to activate Internal Annihilation Mode from 20 to 30.
 	Changed so that the missile explosion attack happens only 1 time.
 	Increased the duration of lever activation during the Scan pattern.
 	Extended the wait time between the consecutive scans during the Scan pattern.
 	Extended the time needed to complete the Security Code Input pattern.
[Orchestra Hall]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Conductor and increased damage received.
 	Changed the max stack of Torment of Inspiration from 3 stacks to 5 stacks.
 	Adjusted so that the max number of notes for HP Threshold Mechanic to 8, 10, 12 depending on the Difficulty Stage.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 3 times, 1 for each pattern.

 	In Difficulty Stage 3, Stage 3 Exclusive or Regular pattern will be chosen at random to be executed.
 	Increased the speed of note check in the Note Check pattern.
 	Improved so that 2 failures are needed to cause the party to wipe in the Difficulty Stage 3 Note Check pattern.
 	Players can now press the Dungeon Function Key to change the moving notes during the Sheet Play pattern.
 	Reduced the damage of note explosion during the Sheet Play pattern.
 	Increased the groggy duration for successful mechanic completion.
 	Extended the Note Activation Time for Skill Check pattern.
 	Improved so that the repeat mark only appears in the last pattern for Difficulty Stage 2 and Difficulty Stage 3.
 	Adjusted the note creation and movement speed during the Sheet Play pattern.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Maestro and increased damage received.
 	Changed so that all dead players will be immediately resurrected before the HP Threshold Mechanic.
 	Reduced the number of notes needed to be played for Personal Performance pattern.
 	Changed so that 4 random players will be picked to perform for Ensemble pattern.
 	Reduced the number of notes needed to be played for Ensemble pattern.
 	Improved the visibility of Piano Performance pattern.
 	Reduced the number of notes needed to be played for Piano Performance pattern.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 2 times, 1 for each pattern.

 	In Difficulty Stage 3, Stage 3 Exclusive or Regular pattern will be chosen at random to be executed.

notes.title: Content Creator Program - July Update
notes.content:
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/czINVlg.jpeg"]

 

Hello Adventurers!

We are excited to be back with another edition of our monthly GM blog series, which covers all of the latest content from the Content Creator Program.

As a reminder, anyone is able to apply to the program if they have interest in creating guides. Head to the official website here to apply.

June was another thrilling month for our creators. Players can check out all 12 of the guides that range from solo raids to individual character paths.

 

Tenebrous armor is an important part of gearing up your characters. NextActRena published a new guide that covers everything you need to know, from shadow effects to reforging and more. NextActRena continues to push out new content regularly to help players through their adventures. Be sure to check out their channel for more great content!



\[embed][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zzWwHcxUy0Q&feature=youtu.be"][/dynamiclink]\[/embed]



 

If you are in need of assistance with force skills, look no further than Fantasmo’s latest guide. Their new guide is part two of helping players understand everything from challenge mode forces to Legendary forces.



\[embed][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tgttbLAXB9A&ab_channel=Fantasmo"][/dynamiclink]\[/embed]



 

For more content, stay up to date with the content creator page. This page is updated weekly with all of the new content if you want to follow closely and see what else the creators have to offer. Here is a look at everything that was published in June.

 

Gameplay Guides

Tenebrous Armor Guide

Advanced Force Skills Guide

Fishing Guide

Pet Expedition & Potion Guide

Varnimyr Raid (Crimson Tower of Howling Flames) Solo Guide

Varnimyr Raid (Never-Ending Darkness) Solo Raid Guide

Varnimyr Raid (Crimson Tower of Howling Flames) Solo Guide

 

Character Guides

Picking a main in Elsword. Is Rena right for you?

Ara Apsara Guide

Ara Surya Guide

Rena Daybreaker Guide

Rena Twilight Guide

 

We look forward to sharing more content with you this upcoming month! Be sure to join the Elsword Discord to keep up to date with all things Elsword.

★ Varnimyr/Pruinaum/Abyss Raid Solo Mode

 	Solo mode will be added to the Varnimyr, Pruinaum, Abyss Raid.

 	The difficulty/progression/reward will be categorized as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/39b527f32250a7d6af7d8687f4defc22b41bed31.jpg

 	The Receive button will be removed from the Rewards UI for the Varnimyr, Pruinaum, and Abyss Raid.

 	Following the removal of the Receive button, players will gain Weapon Drop Gauge and Purification Gauge upon obtaining the weekly reward for each phase’s boss.
 	Players can obtain the raid rewards (Mystic Stone/Imprint Stone Cube, Abyss Aura Purifier) within the dungeon upon clearing each phase.
 	Upon selecting Solo Mode, the ‘Queue for Dungeon (F8)’ button will be changed to ‘Enter Dungeon (F8)’.
 	The Solo Mode will share progression with Normal Mode.

 	For example, players can enter Phase 2 as Normal Mode after clearing Phase 1 as Solo Mode.

 	Players can also enter Phase 2 as Solo Mode after clearing Phase 1 as Normal Mode.
 	Entry to Phase 2 as Solo/Normal Mode is not available when Phase 1 is cleared as Story Mode.
 	The Solo Mode will share the Weekly Reward Count with Normal Mode.
 	 An exclusive buff will be applied upon entering as Solo Mode.

 	All Rounder: 1 of the following buffs will be applied upon entering a dungeon depending on the character’s class.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/64bead09568ad3286ff506d75a644cb3d1e3f5ec.jpg
 	Unbreakable Will: Upon entering the dungeon, receive a buff that grows stronger over time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/7ca9e3577648637451dbdefc51b73fc98b44db52.jpg
 	Players can instantly be resurrected using the Z key in Solo Mode up to 3 times.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/5befb0a81e49e839b8af4e7680caa9bd9c4fc562.jpg
 	Abyss Raid Normal Mode will be changed to be available to progress as a normal party (4 players) instead of a Striker Party.

 	The Abyss Raid Normal Mode progression will be changed to be the same as Story Mode, where players play ‘Sunken Holy Ground’ 1 time, ‘Blooming Mineral Field’ or ‘Nightmare’s Crib’ 1 time, and ‘Birth of Origin’ 1 time in order.
 	The Party Info UI will be changed following the Abyss Raid Normal Mode progression changes.
★ Prof. Pho's Growth Guide Revamp

 	Please check out the detailed mission and rewards list in game after the update on May 21st.
★ Dismantling Amplified Circuit Improvements

 	A filter function dedicated for Amplified Circuits will be added to the Item Dismantle function.

 	Dismantle Circuits at the Set Stat or Below (Socket Stat)

 	Players can set a socket stat to filter out Amplified Circuits with the sockets below the set stat.

 	The stats for Party Buff effect sockets and All Elemental Resistance effect sockets will be marked separately as shown below.
 	Circuit Dismantle Detailed Settings (Socket Type)

 	Players can check all socket types that appear in Amplified Circuits.
 	Checked sockets are included in the filter. Players can select all socket types at once via the Dismantle All button.
 	Auto Dismantle Circuits Upon Identification

 	If ‘Auto Dismantle Circuits Upon Identification’ is checked in the Item Dismantle UI, all identified circuits will be dismantled when there is a circuit that matches the conditions.
 	The Amplified Circuit Filter settings will be saved account-wide.
 	The number of items that can be dismantled at once will be expanded from 30 to 100.

Example) A Tenebrous armor with 20% Guaranteed Success Gauge at +10 will become a Tenebrous armor with 60% Guaranteed Success Gauge at +10 after the improvements.

★ Mailbox UI Improvements

 	The Mailbox UI will be changed

 	When opening the Mailbox UI, the most recently received unopened mail category is selected.
 	System Mail: Menu for viewing System Mail

 	The System Mail is categorized into Account, Character, Bond, Guild.

 	Account: Players can view account-based mail, which can be viewed by all characters in the account.
 	Character: Players can view character-based mail.
 	Bond: Players can view reward mail related to Couple/Marriage and Partner/Soulmate.
 	Guild: Players can view reward mail related to the Guild.
 	The System Mail displays the Title, Attachment (Item Icon), and Deletion Date.
 	Up to 300 System Mail are displayed.

 	Players can view excess mail by clicking the Refresh button after deleting existing mail.
 	The Stewardship Coin reward mail will be sent to the Account Mail.
 	Normal Mail: Menu for viewing mail sent from other players

 	The Normal Mail displays the Title, Attachment, and Sender (Sender’s Nickname).
 	Up to 30 mail items are stored.
 	Send Mail: Menu for sending mail to other players

 	Players can view the Friend/Account List for the character by clicking the + button in the Recipient section. Players can click the Send to Guild Members checkbox to send a group mail to all guild members.

 	Items and ED cannot be attached to Guild Mail.
 	The title is automatically displayed as [‘Your Character’s Nickname’s Mail]. However, this can be edited.
 	Settings ( ): Menu for setting functions such as Mail Blocking

 	Fixed a bug where deleted characters remained in the Block List.
★ Doom Aporia Raid - Wilting Tower Dungeon Separation

 	The Wilting Tower Dungeon of the Doom Aporia Raid will be separated into ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ (Phase 1 & 2) and ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’ (Phase 3).

 	The Dungeon Entry # of Players, Combat Power, Adaptation, and Equipment Requirements remain the same.
 	Players must clear ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ to enter ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’.
 	All players in the party must clear the same stage of ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ to enter ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’ together.
 	The entry stage of ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’ will be based on the cleared stage of ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’.
 	Players must clear ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’ after clearing ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ to obtain Wilting Tower repeat rewards and Undead Dragon’s Heart Fragments.
 	Upon clearing ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’, players cannot re-renter ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’. Instead, players must clear ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ again for re-entry.
 	The weapon advancement quest conditions for the Undead Dragon’s Will - Mortal Weapon will be changed.

★ Serpentium Raid Accessory Guaranteed Acquisition System

 	The ‘Accessory Gauge’ can only be obtained 1 time per week per dungeon regardless of the difficulty.
 	The 'Accessory Gauge' can be obtained equally regardless of the difficulty (Stage 3/4).
 	After players [Receive] the ‘Serpentium Raid Accessory Select Cube’, the gauge will return to 0.
 	The Accessory Gauge will not reset when the Antenna Earrings Cube or Maestro Halo Cube is dropped.

★ Amplified Circuit Drop Rate Improvement

 	Upon defeating the boss in each phase of the Serpentium Raid Stages 3 and 4, players will be guaranteed a T Type Amplified Circuit as a weekly reward.

 	For Lu/Ciel, Lu and Ciel each will have a set effect.
 	Players can register up to 6 [Activated Set Effects], but only up to 3 set effects can be activated to apply the Set Effect stats.

 	Set effects added to this list will remain on the list even if the item is unequipped.
 	Set effects must be in the [Activated Set Effects] list after being equipped to activate the effect.
 	Fixed effects are activated by simply equipping them.
 	If the currently equipped Set Effect changes, the Set Effect will reflect the change without needing to check the UI.
 	The Set Effects List UI is not available (editable) when entering a combat zone (Dungeon, Field, or PvP).

★ Ice Burner Revamp
  As  previously announced in the January 22nd announcement, the following changes will be made to the Ice Burner  system.       We will be  overhauling the entire content set by increasing the drop rate for specific key  items, including the Ice Burner costumes and accessories. Additionally, we will  introduce a new system that allows players to spend Ice Burner Points to obtain  their desired Ice Burner costumes and accessories. The price of Ice Burners  will be adjusted from 100 K-Ching to 160 K-Ching.     Ice Burner Point System      An Ice Burner Point System will be  added that allows players to select an Ice Burner costume or accessory.     Ice Burner Points can be  obtained through using Ice Burners. The number of points obtained varies  depending on the rank of the item obtained.   
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/1cd568702787cf00176fcb61ef39a33bd1caa357.jpg
      When players  reach 100% Ice Burner Points, they can choose 1 of the Ice Burner costumes or  accessories.    Ice Burner  Points obtained in each season are valid until the item’s sale end date. They  will be deleted once the sale ends.          Players can only use Ice Burner Points on  Ice Burner Costumes and Accessories for the corresponding season.      Ice Burner Points cannot be obtained when  using bonus Ice Burners earned through promotions such as 1+1 or  Fireworks Ice Burners.      After reaching 100% Ice Burner Points and  selecting a costume or accessory, the item will be sent to the [Ice Burner  Inventory].      Ice Burner Points are earned on a  per-account basis.        Ice Burner  Content Changes and Rate Adjustments      Certain Items from Ice Burner content will  be removed and added.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/e697646d9783aa9379ae3ab98aeea04a7fbbb813.jpg

      Ice Burner costumes and accessories chances will  be increased.    The existing crafting materials will be  removed, and crafting accessories will be added as part of the Ice Burner  contents accordingly.    Dedicated Ice  Burner Inventory Added      Items obtained from opening Ice Burners will  now be stored in a separate ‘Ice Burner Inventory’.    Ice Burner Inventory is available for shared  account use.    Players can only [Withdraw] from the Ice  Burner Inventory. Items cannot be returned to the inventory space once  withdrawn.  
★Mod Force Skill (Raven/Elesis/Ara/Lu/Ciel/Lithia)
  Mod  Force Skill for Raven, Elesis, Ara, Lu/Ciel and Lithia will be added.  Please  see below for the added Mod Force Skill list.

The extension will extend the end date  for mission progression, rewards obtained, and the custom stats for the Season  Mark until March 25, 2025 at 23:59 PDT. Fixed a bug where the Group Performance  pattern would be scored differently from the host under certain circumstances  in Phase 2 of Orchestra Hall.   Fixed a bug where players  were not able to perform after transforming into an instrument while jumping  during the Ensemble pattern in Orchestra Hall.

Fixed a bug where the  ‘Continue Using’ button UI had unintended movement when used to open multiple  Sealed Relic Burners.  Fixed a bug  where the character’s position did not lock after staying in place for a long  time in certain maps. notes.title: The Stars Shine Brighter than Ever!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/YUgB0Sp.jpeg
Heya, adventurers! I do hope y'all have been helping Farmer Pho on their farm! There are a couple of weeks left still, so work hard and earn those rewards! But don't worry, cause we got something to brighten up your mood! The El★STAR Idols are coming back with new hits! Make sure to take a break, listen to the song previews, and keep an eye out for more juicy details!

Item Mall Goodies

I know that y'all are pumped up for the Idols but make sure to check yourself. Lithia has a new gig, and let's just say Lithia Thanatos might want to visit if any of you happen to take your excitement too far.

https://i.imgur.com/wdDa1GA.jpeg


I heard that the City View is great, even more so if a Theme Park is in town! So, make sure to grab your friends, set it up in your Guild Base and revel in the lively atmosphere it brings! Hurry, before they pack it up and move to the next city!

https://i.imgur.com/iRfZuLK.jpeg

Time's a ticking! Head on over to the Item Mall and get them, cause they ain't gonna stay there for long!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Stand out this Spooky Season with a new Punk-themed outfit!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/HyG7XTu.jpeg

Heya, adventurers! The 2024 Halloween Event is in full blast! But it’s also as good a week as any to take a step back and relax. Just remember to keep filling up your Pumpkin Basket every day for those tasty treats! You wouldn’t want to be tricked now… would you?

Item Mall Goodies

Feeling rebellious? Well, we got the outfit just for you! The Punk Stomp line of clothing will be available this week! Everything does look good in black.

https://i.imgur.com/fJTPRoS.jpeg

But there's more! Take in the sights as you stroll through nature, a Glorious Statue along the path, a nice Elysion Tree to take a break on. Oh, is it raining? Grab a leaf and head to the Small Corner in the Forest to let it pass. All of these custom motions are available just for Lithia!

https://i.imgur.com/ZOCvm6U.gif

Get them at the Item Mall before they get spooked!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Make This Sweet Cutie Your Newest Companion!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/ZMn0Fvc.jpeg

Heya, adventurers! It may seem like a chill week, but is it really? The exciting Harmony Festival in-game events and boosts are still going strong! But that's not all—we've got even more in store for you. Don’t miss out on the fun by participating in our community events like the Harmony Festival Fireworks Event and the Harmony Music Festival Event. Show off your creativity and get a chance to snag some K-Ching! And of course, don’t forget to check out the fabulous new additions in the Item Mall this week!


Item Mall Goodies


Your newest pet, Merry, is as sweet as a strawberry! But don’t be fooled by her cute looks—she’ll take down enemies with her sugar-coated attacks!

https://i.imgur.com/EoB01Ct.gif

Add even more flair to Lithia’s already fire outfits! Don’t miss out on the Elite Tailor, Abandoned Nobility, and Autumn Travels Costume Sets, available starting this week!

https://i.imgur.com/RHKb6mW.jpeg

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Celebrate Another Bountiful Harmony Festival with the El Search Party!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/J5LEjDu.jpeg

Heya adventurers! This week is going to be extra fun and extra bountiful for everyone. Get your inventories for the 2024 Harmony Festival! We have tons of in-game and community events lined up for you and you'll find out more about them soon. But for now, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store!


Harmony Festival Events

Fall feels are starting up! Plenty of rewards await just by logging in and doing super easy tasks!


 Let festival music fill the Elrios' airwaves! Strum along to Noel with your Ukulele and get [Cobo] Noel's Impromptu Music Sheets which you can exchange for awesome rewards! What those rewards are, you just have to find out!
 Don't forget to get your fishing rods ready because Helen has got some rewards to give you in exchange for certain fishes!
 Get ready because the Burning Boost for the duration is FREE ENTRY to the Heroic Dungeon, Elrianode, Pruinaum, Monaterra, and Serpentium! You also get +1 Additional Dungeon Daily Special Reward which stacks with your Elrios Pass effect! Plus, there are more daily Burning Boosts which you wouldn't want to miss out on!
 We also have exclusive Harmony Festival Food! The Harmony Festival Pie is totally FREE!
 The bonfire site is back! Hang out in there for a minimum of 1 minute to get dungeon-exclusive boosts like: Physical/Magical Attack Power 5% Increase, EXP 50%, and Adaptation 3%!
 And there's truly so much more happening which you have to check out on your own!


Item Mall Goodies

Nothing scares weak-willed enemies more than stern-looking heroes! Dress up in either the black or white coloration of the newest Iconic Record Costume Sets this week!

https://i.imgur.com/vghmN0K.jpeg

Harness the shadows or control Time and Space; Lithia's ready for both! Choose to complete one or both of Lithia's newest fits: Black Mass or Henir - Lord of Time and Space IB Sets.

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

★ New Equipment – Exascale Armor
New Equipment: Exascale Armor

 	Exascale Armor refined from special metals found in the Land of Steel is updated.
 	Exascale Armor can be obtained directly from Epic Quests or crafted with Circuit Fragments through Camp: Steel Wall’s NPC Haivan.

 	 Circuit Fragments can be obtained by disassembling Amplified Circuits and System Chips
Exascale Armor Reforge
[Exascale Armor Reforge]

 	A system that allows players to make their Exascale Armor stronger. Each Reforge Stage increases the Exascale Armor's stats and adds Reforge effects.
 	Reforge can be done through each villages’ Blacksmiths.
 	Exascale Reforge can be attempted with one of the following materials: Refined Exikel or Zetrium Steel.

This system is identical to the existing reforge system, excluding Reforge Material and Option per Reforge Stage.
[Reforge Transfer System]

 	Reforge Transfer is a system that allows players to move Tenebrous Armor's Reforge Stage to Exascale Armor.
 	Tenebrous Armor must be Reforge Stage 18 or higher and can only be transferred to the armor with the same item part.
 	There are 2 types of Reforge Transfer, Normal Reforge Transfer and Special Reforge Transfer.
[table]
[tr]

Transfer[/td]

Transfer[/td]

The higher the Reforge Stage, the more it would cost.
Reforge Stage Transfer Ticket can be purchased in the Item Mall.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
 	The number of materials needed for Reforge Transfer differs depending on the Reforge Stage players wish to transfer. The transfer done will be 6 stages lower than the starting Reforge Stage.

 	(EX. Tenebrous Armor +18 Reforge Stage will become Exascale Armor +12 Reforge Stage upon Reforge Transfer.)
System Chip Tuning

 	Players can earn unsealed System Chips by playing Raid Dungeons, which can then be used for [Chip Tuning] through Camp: Steel Wall’s NPC Haivan.
 	System chips that has completed tuning can be equipped to the new armor.

 	Only system chips with 0 remaining tuning counts can be equipped to Exascale.
 	Only unlocked System Chips can be attempted for Tuning, and can be equipped.
 	Equipped system chips can be overwritten by other system chips.
[Chip Tuning Details]

 	Upon pressing the Tuning button, it will either be success or fail based on chance.

 	ED is required for Tuning Attempts.

 	‘Amplified Circuit’ can be purchased through the Shop or by playing dungeons, and can be equipped onto new armor through the Circuit Amplification UI.
 	Amplified Circuit has 4 different categories: color, shape, slot, and option.

notes.title: Discover New Lands and Rally Beneath the Sky Fortress!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/XWThcDk.jpeg

Heya adventurers! Let us welcome another action-packed week and explore the newest region that's coming out - Serpentium! Fight new enemies, explore novel surroundings, and interact with NPCs in this newly opened region. What's more is that plenty of simple tasks will reap amazing rewards, so don't miss out! And as always, don't forget to check out the wonderful new things we have the Item Mall just for you!


Path to Becoming Stronger Event

08/28/2024 - 09/24/2024 (23:59 PDT)

After the Punch Master hype, we have another epic event that requires very little effort to get amazing rewards! Just complete simple quest conditions to get your hands on rewards such as: 1,500 Tenebrous Auras, [Cobo] Consumable Bundles, and more!


Serpentium Update Event

08/28/2024 - 09/10/2024 (23:59 PDT)

Experience what kind of power Serpentium has to offer! Just login for 10 cumulative minutes to get your hands on a [Cobo] Serpentium Region Trial Cube!


2024 Labor Day Event

09/02/2024 (00:00 - 23:59 PDT)

Spend your well-earned holiday with Elsword and the gang because rewards and an epic burning event awaits! A total of 20 cumulative login minutes will get you 1 [Cobo] Unlimited Refined Recovery Potion and 1 [Cobo] Unlimited Fighter Potion! Enjoy x2 Item Drop Rate for 24-hours!


Item Mall Goodies

Head into the coast and enjoy the refreshing summer breeze as you don the newest Chifon Costar Costume Set! Leave your heavy equipment behind and relax!

https://i.imgur.com/WtYiggG.jpeg


Lithia leaves her worries behind as she enjoys a unique teatime experience with Pink/Sky Teatime Splash Custom Motion! Now here's a different way to cool off!

https://i.imgur.com/GuGWm4G.jpeg

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Keep Punching Up! Make Your Way to the Top and Become Even Stronger!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/HL3LHRj.jpeg

Heya adventurers! Last week was an action-packed one so it's going to be a chill week! We want you to complete all the events like get your very own Vestige of Soul from the VoS Weapon Provision Event, if you haven't yet. And don't forget to level up your Resonance or increase you Combat Power with the Hyper Punch Master Event as well as the Clear the Raid Events that are still ongoing! Also, don't forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall for this week!


Item Mall Goodies
Lithia's closet is getting new additions! Embody elegance and exude a mystical aura with her newest Aurora Mustika Ice Burner Set. Don't forget the complete her look with Aurora Eyes! She can also choose to exude erudition with her very own Velder Academy Knight Ice Burner Set!

https://i.imgur.com/iMTtPBH.jpeg

https://i.imgur.com/MJOT40x.jpeg

Don't forget to add a mesmerizing flair to Lithia's powerups with her very own Awakening!

https://i.imgur.com/t0EKalG.jpeg[image]


Summer's here again and so are these beloved and cool costumes. Get ready to sail and hunt not only sharks but baddies with the Shark Hunter Costume Set. Flaunt your fashion sense to the streets and show your rebel side with Street Star Costume Set. Summers are for relaxation and chilling with friends, don the Retro Picnic Set today!

https://i.imgur.com/o4OnhF7.jpeg
https://i.imgur.com/w38b8cY.png

That's all for now folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Unleash Your Draconic Spirit and Break Power Ceilings with Hyper Punch Master!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/HlrgEZP.jpeg

Heya adventurers! Hold on to your seats because it's going to be an extremely jam-packed week as your ascend to power begins! Punch your way to the top but this time we're making it a little more challenging with the Hyper Punch Master Event. But that's not all, find out how you can get your hands on a +11 Vestige of Soul below. To top it all off get ready for an exciting weekend of burning with the Summer Update Special Burning Event! And don't forget, Elrios Pass Season 8 has begun, maximize your adventures and don't dawdle.  And as always, whether it's a chill of action-packed weekend, don't forget to take a look at the fun items we have at the Item Mall this week!


Solace PVP Championship (2v2 Tournament)
With the new PVP updates we couldn’t resist hosting a tournament to test out the new additions and feature even more classes from the last time we held one! Registration is now open until August 18th (23:59 PDT) for Solace (NA) players, so find your duo partner and register! Those who make it to Top 8 are guaranteed prizes, including K-Ching or even cold hard cash! If you need help with finding a partner, reach out to our GMs to assist you!

You can register at the following link:
https://elsword.koggames.com/elsword-solace-pvp-championship/


Hyper Punch Master (HPM) & Clear the Raid Event
08/14/2024 – 10/08/2024 (23:59 PDT)
Becoming powerful is a truly arduous journey but we're here to reward your chosen character every step of the way! Reach a milestone, get rewards - it's that simple!
• Start racking up rewards through HPM if your Combat Power is anywhere below 9 Million!
• Don't miss out on the Hyper Punch Master Burning Event where you'll get a buff of Adaptation 20% as well as get increased Resonance Level through the Resonance Burning Event!
• Then immediately continue with even better rewards through Clear the Raid Event once your combat power reaches above 9 Million!
• Get Senpai Points ♥ when you clear Pruinaum and Abyss Raids and exchange your points for useful rewards!


+11 Vestige of Soul Weapon Provision Event
08/14/2024 – 10/08/2024 (23:59 PDT)
This is not a drill. I repeat, this is not a drill! Just complete a cumulative login time of 60 MINUTES to get not only a [Cobo] Weapon Growth Quest Count x3 Medal - Vestige of Soul (1 Day) Cube, but also get a [Cobo] +11 Vestige of Soul - Weapon of Requiem Cube. Don't miss your chance!


Summer Update Special Burning Event
08/17/2024 (00:00 - 23:59 PDT)
Take your weekends to the level and make it hotter with a 24-hour burning event! For a whole day you can level up your ERP with a Resonance Burning (does not stack with HPM Resonance Burning) and with just 10 minutes of cumulative login, you can get [Cobo] Unlimited Potion 2 Kinds (1 Day) Cube!


Item Mall Goodies
Harness the power of the epic mythical creatures with the IB: Ascending Dragon. Enemies will flee at the sight majestic presence! Complete the whole set this week!

https://i.imgur.com/S5WvEuN.jpeg[image]



Move with grace and dance with purpose with the newest Costume Suit: Pure White Attitude! Step left and right like a majestic swan with the included Custom Motion!

https://i.imgur.com/LZpMPs0.jpeg

https://i.imgur.com/zoAbTYZ.gif

Lithia will never feel thirst again with her newest custom motion that's perfect for sweltering hot summers! Let her cool off with her very own Sparkling Shower Custom Motion and let the heat dissipate!

https://i.imgur.com/o50gyBq.jpeg[image]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.content:
https://tinyurl.com/mr45fa3a

Hello, Elpeeps!

We are excited to announce the 2v2 Solace PvP Championship! This tournament features a cash prize pool alongside numerous changes to the format based on player feedback. Check out the details below and head to the official website to register now: https://elsword.koggames.com/elsword-solace-pvp-championship/!

Registration Period: August 5th (Mon) ~ August 18th (Sun) 23:59 PDT

Tournament Dates

●	Day 1: August 23rd (Fri) 17:00 PDT
●	Day 2: August 24th (Sat) 12:00 PDT
●	Day 3: August 31st (Sat) 12:00 PDT

Prizes

Listed prizes are per team.

●	1st Place: $300
●	2nd Place: $150
●	3rd Place: $100
●	4th-8th Place: 2,000 K-Ching


Livestream Information

All tournament matches will be livestreamed on Twitch (https://www.twitch.tv/elsword) and YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@Elsword) at the start time for each tournament date.

We will be hosting three giveaways per date of 500 K-Ching. Additionally, channel points can be used to enter into two additional giveaways for each date. If you are looking for a way to get more points, viewers will be able to vote for a winner each match to earn more throughout the tournament.

Showmatch Event

Tune in for a special livestream on August 16th (Fri) at 17:00 PDT to catch the competitors in action. We will be hosting a series of showmatches for participants to get some additional practice and scout the competition. These matches may be for fun, but expect a good showing from the teams!

For more up-to-date information, join the Elsword Discord at https://discord.gg/Elsword.

We will see you for the action soon!

notes.title: Hedgehog is Here to Bring Wonderful Rewards!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/V3XvE6j.jpeg

Heya adventurers! Don't miss your chance for exciting activities and plentiful rewards this week! Hedgehog Draw Lots is back so you can get free prize tickets just by logging in! Also, Class Change Chance is here to let you experience something different. And as always, don't forget to check out the wonderful things we have at the Item Mall for this jam-packed week!


Hedgehog Draw Lots Event
07/31/2024 - 08/13/2024 (23:59 PDT)
 Your daily log ins will not go unrewarded! Get prize tickets and accumulate them! You'll get a plethora of useful rewards for your adventures!
 When you clear dungeons within your level range 3 times daily, you'll get 1 Prize Ticket.
 Clearing 10 dungeons within your level range weekly will give you 2 Prize Tickets!
 The more you draw, the better the rewards you'll get! Get your hands on rewards like: [Luriel] Adventurer Support Potions, [Luriel] El Tree Seeds, a [Cobo] Spectral Amethyst or Tenebrous Aura Select Cube, and so much more!



Class Change Event
07/31/2024 – 08/13/2024 (23:59 PDT)

Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on 1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube for the first 30 cumulative minutes and 1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!


Item Mall Goodies
Don't waste your time under the sun. Go out and don an active look as you jog through the boundaries of sand and sea with the Sporty Summer Costume Set! Coming this week to the Item Mall!

https://i.imgur.com/xnusIUb.jpeg

Take a piece of the ocean out and swim your way to relaxation in the streets of Elrios with Lithia's newest Ocean's Dance Custom Motion!

https://i.imgur.com/iD8ZOaO.jpeg

Missed your chance to get these beloved mounts? Here's your chance to cop or more! Check out the Reorder Shop for Summon Stones and grab your favorite ride this week!

https://i.imgur.com/zorKdBv.jpeg

And so much more!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: No Time to Cool Off! Raven's Challenges Continue to Bring on the Heat!

Heya adventurers! It's going to be a chill week because we know you have Raven's Summer Camp Event on your minds. notes.title: Turn Up the Heat as Raven Takes Charge of Your Summer!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/vLrk6GO.jpeg
Heya adventurers! This week, we're ready to get you into tip top shape with Raven's Summer Camp Event so for sure it's going to be extremely action-packed! Also, don't forget to cast your vote on the Lithia 4th Path Summer Art Contest Voting Event. You have a chance to win K-Ching if one of the artists you voted placed in the top 3, so check that out if you haven't yet. And as always, don't forget to take a gander at the Item Mall for all the fun goodies we have for this week!

Raven's Summer Camp Event

07/17/2024 - 08/13/2024 (23:59 PDT)

You think Summer's all about relaxation and fun and the sun? It is, but Raven's ready to put a challenging twist to your days so you emerge stronger!


 Raven's Summer Camp has a total of 4 normal stages and 1 Extreme stage. Finish the chain quests in each stage to move on to another stage. If you don't then you can't move on. Extreme Stage will only unlock once all 4 stages have been conquered!

 These challenges aren't just laughs, though. Every quest you finish will get you rewards such as: [Luriel] Red Bean Sherbets, [Luriel] Sage's Magic Stones, [Cobo] Shining Mystic Stone Cubes, and so much more!

 Also, finishing a whole stage will get you an extra special reward. You'll find out what it is when the event starts!

 The Extreme quest can be done as many times as you can possibly do it! Choose 1 Special reward every time you finish it!


Item Mall Goodies

You can now live in the pinnacle of grandeur and majesty with the El House DIY: Hall of the Sun set. Invite your friends, worshippers, and even enemies so you can show off how you live in ultimate opulence!

Ain, Laby, Noah, and Lithia are getting their new threads! Enemies will wish that the odds are in their favor when you "entertain" them in the Trump Bunny Costume Set (Ain- Lithia)! And show them how fluid you are that whether you're wearing skirts or pants the April Fool's Maid and Butler Costume (Laby-Lithia) was made for you!

Put on your Light Denim Overalls Costume Suit because Lithia came fresh from farm! But if you want to park your yacht in the streets of Elrios, Lithia can whip out her Black Ocean or Blue Ocean Custom Motion!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/rsIKOSJ.jpeg

Heya adventurers! It's going to be a fun week with the introduction of a new event. It's very simple with an extremely unique and fun reward, so look forward to it! Also, we've already laid out a pretty rough schedule of our biggest summer updates (you can proceed to the website to check it out), so look forward for that as well. And as always, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the fun goodies we have instore for everyone this week!

Block Weapon Making Event

06/05/2024 - 07/02/2024 (23:59 PDT)

Create your very own weapon that will certainly turn heads when completed! We've got the blueprints and all you have to do is make progress towards completion by completing quests! More details will be coming along this week so stay tuned!


Item Mall Goodies

Spring has sprung and the season of knot tying has begun! Dress for the occasion and impress your loved one with the Eternal Promise Costume Set in two colors! Match each other or show your contrasting personalities when it comes out this week!

https://i.imgur.com/8g04355.jpeg

Pop one of the most important questions of your life with this new, romantic motion! They'll no doubt say yes when you go down on one knee with the Surprise Gift for You Custom Motion!

https://i.imgur.com/4MsW93a.jpeg

Lithia's arsenal of powerful Ice Burners is growing! This week, you can choose to complete her ominous Dark Shadows IB Set, her chilling Glacial IB Set, or her mech-tastic Nasod Battle Suit MK2 IB Set!

https://i.imgur.com/BIwG5re.jpeg
https://i.imgur.com/GV4c272.jpeg


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Time is of the Essence! Punch Through Limits Quickly!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/6UZKtdA.jpeg

Heya adventurer! This week will be a great week to get stronger! Powerful Punch Master and Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master events are back to guide you and deliver rewards as you punch your way to power! Class Change Event has also returned so you could try out try out different paths to elevate your gameplay experience! And as always, don’t forget to check out the many wonderful things we have at the Item Mall!

Powerful Punch Master (PPM) & Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master (LB!PPM)

05/22/2024 – 06/18/2024 (23:59 PDT)

Becoming powerful is a truly arduous journey but we're here to reward your chosen character every step of the way! Reach a milestone, get rewards - it's that simple!


 Start racking up rewards through PPM at 300,000 CP until 1,500,000 CP!
 Then immediately continue with even better rewards through LB! PPM at 1,600,00 until 3,000,000 CP!
 Apart from getting rewards for each Combat Power milestone achieved, you'll get additional rewards just by clearing dungeons within your level range 10 times weekly for both PPM and LB! PPM events!
 But that's not all! Get a powerful boost with Weapon +11 Buff and Adaptation 20% Buff for the duration of the events! However, please remember that these effects do not stack on characters participating.


Class Change Event

05/22/2024 – 06/04/2024 (23:59 PDT)

Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on 1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube for the first 30 cumulative minutes and a 1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!

Item Mall Goodies

Another powerful set has made its way to Elrios! With the new Tourbillon Assemble Ice Burner Set, you’ll become the master of time. Watch out for it this week in the Item Mall!

https://i.imgur.com/Z3tCXlR.jpeg

A cute, new companion is ready to tug on your heartstrings. Time is ticking so don't delay with taking the newest Pet Nona as your new forever friend!

https://i.imgur.com/JSQtqss.gif

Lithia is ready to patrol and take charge as she traverses Elrios' seas with the Hamel Navy Officer Ice Burner Set! Or she can become a mythical, mystical creature with the Holy Unicorn Ice Burner Set!

https://i.imgur.com/2sE54b8.jpeg

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

 Who else can decode the secrets of the rift but Lithia herself? Complete Lithia’s Research Paper and rack up tons of rewards!

★Secret Dungeon Reward ED Adjustment  Pre-Announcement 

From the overall ED Gain data  collected from last year 2023-12-06 Secret Dungeon Revamp  update to now, we believe that the polarization of obtainable ED has been  partly resolved.

However, we have noticed the ED Gain  from Secret Dungeons have increased 4 times since the Secret Dungeon update,  and the overall ED Gain up to 2 times. This numbers have far over-exceeded our  expectations, and brings concern that it may be a major factor in ED value  dropping in the long run. To prevent this outcome, we will be adjusting some of  Secret Dungeon ED Gain.

When looking at the ED Gain per CP stage in the Secret dungeon, the farming  based on CP has been functioning mostly as intended. We intend to adjust the ED  gain only in stage 3 and stage 4, as the amount of ED gained from stage 1 and  stage 2 have not been extensive, and we acknowledge the importance of  early-game ED acquisition. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/a5e2c80ff5a879153b370a8468dc457a6eddb102.png

We understand that the issue of adjusting the amount of ED gain is a sensitive  matter and approach it as such, especially because ED acquisition is directly  connected to the game’s economy.

However, even with all  this consideration, we believe the current ED gain in Secret Dungeon will have  a major impact in future ED value and the overall game economy; therefore, it  is imperative to make adjustments now.
  
The above adjustments  will be applied with the 4-24 maintenance. We will continue to check on the issue of ED Gain  and make sure that all Elsword adventurers can enjoy a stable game environment.

notes.title: Enter the Year of the Wood Dragon and Celebrate with Elsword and the Gang!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Opbs149.jpeg
Heya adventurers! Advance Happy Lunar New Year! It's still a few days away but we can't contain the exciting celebration and events we have in-store for all of you! For a bit of recap: don't forget that we currently have Powerful Punch Master and Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master to make you even stronger and fill your inventory with amazing goodies! Also currently happening is the Adventure Support Attendance Event where you get a random number of a featured weekly item! Don't forget to check out the other two events such as the: Class Change Event and the Budding Sprout Event! And as always, don't forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall for this week!


Lunar New Year Event

02/10/2024 (00:00 - 23:59 PST)

Celebrate the Lunar New Year with us! We've got tons of events and a plethora of amazing rewards to fill up your inventories! Better not miss this because this event only lasts for 24 hours!

Your 10 minutes of cumulative login time will reward you with a [Cobo] When Spring Comes Costume Suit (1 Day) and a [Cobo] Respectful Bow Idle Motion (1 Day).
When you clear dungeons within your level range a total of 9 times, you'll get a [Cobo] Respectful Bow Idle Motion Cube and a [Luriel] Hedgehog Lucky Bag!


Enhancement Events

02/07/2024 - 03/05/2024 (23:59 PST)

Level up your weapons and reach unimaginable power!

Choose to clear dungeons or win 10 PVP matches to get your hands on 1 [Luriel] El's Hammer (30 Days), 5 [Cobo] Blessed Fluorite Ores, and 3 [Cobo] Blessed Restoration Scrolls!
But that's not all! Login once for 10 cumulative minutes to receive 1 [Cobo] Lucky Enhancement Equipment (2) Cube! A must-have when you're trying to take your equipment to peak levels!


Magmelia Fireworks Event

02/07/2024 - 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)

Here's your chance to complete Aether Nobilitas! You must first gather Magmelia Fireworks Exchange Tickets which you can get from special Magmelia Fireworks IB Package or Lithia's Magmelia Firework's IB Package at the Item Mall. Once you have enough tickets, you can exchange them for a set number Ice Burners which can range from 1 up to 100 IBs!


Magmelia Gift Shop Event

02/07/2024 - 03/05/2024 (23:59 PST)

Accumulate Betty Points when you purchase from the Item Mall! Get enough and complete the powerful Rosa Lethe (Black) Ice Burner Set as well as other amazing rewards!


Item Mall Goodies

Lithia's definitely not going to be left behind - not in fashion, at least! With two new Ice Burners just for her she'll definitely feel she belongs in the group! Get the El Search Party and Archdevil Ice Burner Sets this week!

https://i.imgur.com/Y4QhV7H.jpeg

https://i.imgur.com/3hfq2GB.jpeg


It's still a little chilly but the little buds of Spring are slowly but surely popping up! Be ready to greet the new season with the When Spring Comes Out Costume Suit and pair it with the Respectful Bow Custom Motion!

https://i.imgur.com/AbBs3S9.jpeg

https://i.imgur.com/gKLpSYd.gif


If you're a cool-toned gal or guy and want to immerse yourself in those kinds of colors, then check out the newest Hair Color Palette in Aurora Nocturne for your cool-as-a-cucumber hair dyes!

https://i.imgur.com/NoL2Hdr.jpeg


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Gain the Power to Punch Through Anything!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/giw5FYX.jpeg

Heya adventurers! Hold on to your hats because this week is going to be extremely jam-packed! You had your chill week but now, we're ramping things up with exciting events and a plethora of sweet rewards! Grab your partner and unleash your draconic spirit to welcome the Lunar New Year with a 2v2 tourney! Sign-up (if you haven't yet) and you can win TONS of K-Ching plus the recognition of being one of Elrios' strongest warriors! And as always, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store this week!


Powerful Punch Master (PPM) & Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master (LB!PPM)

1/31/2024 – 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)

Becoming powerful is a truly arduous journey but we're here to reward your chosen character every step of the way! Reach a milestone, get rewards - it's that simple!

 Start racking up rewards through PPM at 300,000 CP until 1,500,000 CP!
 Then immediately continue with even better rewards through LB! PPM at 1,600,00 until 3,000,000 CP!
 Apart from getting rewards for each Combat Power milestone achieved, you'll get additional rewards just by clearing dungeons within your level range 3 times for both PPM and LB! PPM events!
 But that's not all! Get a powerful boost with Weapon +11 Buff and Adaptation 20% Buff for the duration of the events! However, please remember that these effects do not stack on characters participating.


Cobo Company Attendance Event
1/31/2024 – 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)

Your weekly logins have a chance to give you more! Just login once a week for 30 cumulative minutes and get the weekly featured cube that when opened would give you a random number of the item featured!


Class Change Event
1/31/2024 – 02/13/2024 (23:59 PST)

Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on 1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube for the first 30 cumulative minutes and a 1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!


Consumable Support Event
1/31/2024 – 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)

Which of your characters need the most support in their journey to the top? In this event, it doesn't matter if their level 1 or 99, just input their names in the UI and they'll immediately receive 1 [Cobo] Budding Sprout Gift Cube that contains useful consumables they can utilize during their journeys!


Item Mall Goodies

With Lithia's successful debut into the El Search Party, comes her full fledged debut as an ELSTAR idol! Check her out as a member of Mega Cake and get her all the bells and whistles that idol life has to offer: Custom Motions, Accessories, and more!

https://i.imgur.com/3EdXKFp.jpeg
https://i.imgur.com/a4UsBAg.jpeg
https://i.imgur.com/Cq6W9Us.jpeg


ELSTAR is coming back for everyone! ACE, MEGA CAKE, ALTER CROWN, and MAZE costumes, accessories, custom motions, and more have returned so that your characters can take a break from being a hero and experience the idol life for a change!

https://i.imgur.com/1dBUGQe.jpeg
https://i.imgur.com/QyIfh7m.jpeg


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Lithia's Debut is Imminent! Be Sure to Pre-Register!

Heya adventurer! We're a week away from Christmas so get ready for a busy and abundant week ahead! And whether you celebrate the occasion or not, we've got tons of event for you to enjoy and even more rewards to get your hands on! Also, don't forget to Pre-Register for Lithia's launch or you won't get the extra special rewards! Elrios Pass Season 6

You’re in luck because this week, Elrios Pass Season 6 is here! Get your hands on even more rewards when you complete new Season Missions!

and more!

notes.title: Get Ready for a Bountiful Festival Month! Harmony Festival is Back!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/SqeoIFp.jpg

Heya adventurers! Whether you like the smell and taste of Pumpkin Spice, it's that time of year again! You know what else is back? The Harmony Festival is! But that's not all, Prof. Pho Attendance Event is also returning because we really want to fill all your inventories in preparation for the coming cold season! And as always, don't forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall for this week!


Harmony Festival Events
Fall feels are starting up! Plenty of rewards await just by logging in and doing super easy tasks! 

 Want to help out during the festival? Deliver food to the customers to get [Cobo] Harmony Festival Exchange Tickets which you can exchange for awesome rewards! What those rewards are, you just have to find out!
 Don't forget to get your fishing rods ready because Helen has got some rewards to give you in exchange for certain fishes!
 Get ready because the Burning Boost for the duration is FREE ENTRY to Elrianode, Secret Dungeons, Heroic Dungeons, Pruinaum, and Monaterra! You also get +1 Additional Dungeon Daily Special Reward which stacks with your Elrios Pass effect! Plus, there are more daily Burning Boosts which you wouldn't want to miss out on!
 We also have exclusive Harmony Festival Food! The Harmony Festival Pie is totally FREE!
 The bonfire site is back! Hang out in there for a minimum of 1 minute to get boosts like: Physical/Magical Attack Power 5% Increased in Dungeon and Fields, EXP 50%, and Adaptation 3%!
 And there's truly so much more happening which you have to check out on your own!


Prof. Pho's Attendance Event
You want rewards? Well, we got ‘em! All you have to do is log-in every day for 14 days to get goodies like: Spectral Amethysts, Dungeon Entrance Tickets, [Luriel] Sage's Magic Stones, Elixirs, Potions, and so much more!


Item Mall Goodies
Go get your cottagecore aesthetics! With the new Cozy Garden Costume Set, you'll look like you're having a cozy time even in the midst of an intense battle!

https://i.imgur.com/TTTI2RS.jpg

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/D3D8Nwa.jpg
Heya adventurers! The action-packed weeks just continues! How are y'all loving these back-to-back events? Are your inventories filled to the brim? This week, you better hold on to your bags because we're smashing through the Great Steel Wall to defeat a new boss! And as always, don't forget to take a gander at the Item Mall for all the fun and new things we have instore!


The Great Steel Wall Event

Get ready for another great challenge in the land of demons. The best part of course is after the fight, and you get rewarded for your hard! Clamber on to the Great Steel Wall and prove your mettle!

Get a taste of Monattera with a [Cobo] The Great Steel Wall Trial Cube as well as other rewards including Sage's Magic Stones, Spectral Amethysts, Tenebrous Auras, and more!
Once you're ready to conquer the Great Steel Wall, get rewarded with [Luriel] Steel Wall Keys so you can keep coming back!


Super Growth Event

Come to Elrios and grow in power! The growth continues with a newly created character that will receive all these help and amazing rewards!

Create a new character that will be receiving all the amazing rewards we have to offer!
Reach level milestones with that character and haul your rewards! Once again fill your inventory with high value consumables, an epic weapon, Camilla's Secret Manuals, and so much more!


Plus Alpha Event

The Plus Alpha Event continues but with the brand-new Nox Venator Ice Burner! Here's your chance to complete this amazing set!


Item Mall Goodies

Careful where you thread at night especially if you plan to do something shady. The El Search Party patrols the night donning the Nox Venator Ice Burner Set ready to take down enemies in a heartbeat! Complete it this week!

https://i.imgur.com/FjbD9Eb.jpg

That's all for now folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: The Action Never Stops! Get Ready for the Epic Event Exclusive Rewards!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/6TYwld5.jpg

Heya adventurers! You think it's going to be an easy week, huh? Well let's break the pattern a bit because this week is going to be extremely jam-packed, yet again! The Enhancement Event includes the many faves like the beloved Enhancement Event, everyone's favorite Find the Hedgehog Event, and the good ol' Plus Alpha Events! And as always, don't forget to take a look at the Item Mall for all the fun goodies we have in store!


Enhancement Events

Elsword just keeps getting better! Enjoy your week with these series of events that will keep you on your toes and fill your inventories to the brim!
 Here’s your chance to complete the Dreaming Automata Ice Burner in the Plus Alpha Event if you haven't yet!
 Plus, this is the perfect time to enhance your weapons or gears with everyone’s favorite Enhancement Event!
 You can get even more Dreaming Automata Ice Burners and even get the event exclusive Sanctus Seraphim (Black) pieces on the Find the Hedgehog! Event!
 Plus, you get to enjoy plenty of amazing deals! Find out what those are this week!



Item Mall Goodies

Is the outside too hot to handle? Jump into your very own refreshing pool after a day of beating enemies and sweating. There's nothing like a relaxing swim in your Mini Pool Custom Motion after a hard day's work!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

★ New Region & Dungeon Update – Monaterra
 	New Region Monaterra is added and New Dungeons ‘Palace of Gold Medovine’, ‘Hunter’s Hideout’, and ‘Torta Arena’ are updated. 	You must clear To a New Region > ‘Entering Monaterra’ Epic Quest to access Monaterra region. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/852aefb577d1b49a84d75fa53a689906c5f10f6d.jpg
 	You need an entrance ticket (Torta Clan’s Invitation) to enter ‘Torta Arena’. 	Torta Clan’s Invitation can be obtained as daily special rewards when playing Monaterra region dungeon.★ Modification System Added
 	New Item: Harconium Tuning Reactor 	The item based on Monaterra machinery, Harconium Tuning Reactor, is updated. 	Harconium Tuning Reactor item is used to modify armor. You can obtain them directly as a drop from Monaterra dungeons or can be crafted through Magmelia NPC Vasili by collecting Harconium Steel. 	Harconium Steel can be obtained by dismantling Harconium Tuning Reactor items. 	Harconium Tuning Reactor items can be obtained from ‘Palace of Gold Medovine’, ‘Hunter’s Hideout’, and ‘Torta Arena’ dungeons. 	Armor Modification 	Armor Modification system allows you to make Tenebrous armor even stronger by imbuing modification effects to Tenebrous Armor through Harconium Tuning Reactor’s additional effects. 	Modification effect is activated when equipping 4 kinds of Tenebrous Armor with modification effect open. 	Even if they are not identical effects, as long as 4 Tenebrous Armor with modification effect open are equipped, modification effect will be activated.
★ Other QoL Improvements
 	Characters participating in Guild Expedition can also be kicked or leave from the guild. 	If there are guild expedition rewards that haven’t been received when kicked or leaving the guild, the unreceived rewards will be immediately sent to the mailbox. 	Adaptation Elixir buff durations have been increased to 30 min. 	Dungeon/Field Big Head debuff effect and Dwarf’s Potion is removed. 	Demon Realm Energy or Consumable items crafted using Demon Realm Energy have been changed as ‘tradeable’. 	Certain requirements for Random Mission has been removed or improved. Information on certain items’ effects and effect duration has been added to certain item descriptions to make the effects of certain consumable/elixir items clearer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/cbb9fbd5259e83b9ecda1a3e932ca89dd849f539.jpg

Clicking on the hourglass icon at the bottom of the Inventory UI will allow you to check temporary items within the inventory. 	Sort locking feature that locks certain items in the desired slots unaffected by inventory sort function is added. 	An inventory item search function is added. 	When searching for items, a list will be shown. Click on the list to move to the inventory page where the item is stored. The item slot of the clicked item will be accepted. 	Equipped items (Fishing, Artifact included), and items in Shared Bank/Pet Inventory cannot be searched. 	Max number of pages that can be expanded for Equipment ~ Costume Inventory has increased. notes.title: The El Search Party Continues and Enter a New Region!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/sn3Ft9e.jpg
Heya adventurers! Hold on to your mounts because it's going to an extremely jam-packed week! First, we open the gates to Monaterra where you'll find out what's next for the El Search Party as they continue their story! Next, is of course the many events and rewards that follow as the new region is unveiled! And, lastly, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the goodies we have for you this week!



Monaterra Update Event

Elsword and the gang continue their adventures as they brave a new region. Participate in the events and plenty of epic rewards will follow!

Want to get a taste of new Monaterra accessories and haul in other rewards? All you need to do is clear dungeons within your level range 3 times!
Start beating up enemies in Monaterra's dungeons! Once you've beaten enough, you'll get 10 Harconium Steel weekly for each completed dungeon milestone!
And for this weekend only, enjoy EXP x2 and DROP RATE x2!


Class Change Event

Waiting for your chance to change things up? Now's your chance! It's as easy as staying logged in for a total of 60 cumulative minutes to get your hands on 1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube and a 1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket!





Item Mall Goodies

Elevate your summer style with hints of mild pirate-esque feel! Don the Pearl Mermaid Costume Set and enjoy the summer season without breaking a sweat!

https://i.imgur.com/WNXO3QM.jpg



That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Nickname Reset Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Players,

In order to have more nicknames available for more adventurers, nicknames will be reset for accounts that have not been logged in for a long period. Please find the detailed information below.

[Nickname Reset Announcement]


– Reset Date: 2023-08-30 00:00 Pacific Time
– Reset Target: Character nickname that hasn’t logged on since 2020-09-01 00:00 Pacific Time
– Details and Warning:

[olist]
 Login data is checked per account instead of per character, so as long as at least 1 character was logged in since the target date, none of the character nicknames on the account will be reset.
 Even when the nicknames are reset, all other game information will still remain, and upon logging in, you can change to a new nickname.
 If you wish to keep your nicknames, please make sure to log in to at least 1 character in your account by 2023-08-30 00:00 Pacific Time.
 Reset names cannot be restored, and other adventurers will be able to claim them.
 The dates when the reset nicknames become available for use will be announced at a later date.
[/olist]

We will always strive to keep Elsword a fun experience for everyone.

Thank you.
-Elsword Team


https://elsword.koggames.com/2023/08/nickname-reset-announcement/
