[Announcements]

★ Pruinaum Raid Challenge Mode

Pruinaum Raid Challenge Mode can be  challenged as a Striker Party and is separated to dungeons that separate the 8  players into 2 parties and dungeons that have all 8 players enter together.
  
Dungeon  Entry Requirements

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/22ea608071254a59a40314aaf1c1452743616d38.jpg


Enter  Challenge Mode
  Each dungeon for Pruinaum Raid  Challenge Mode has a time limit and the countdown will start the moment on  clicking the ‘Challenge Start’ button.  Clear records are reset every  week on Wednesday, and the Challenge Mode you can enter will change.
    After the 4/12 update until 4/19, players  can enter Pruinaum Raid Challenge Mode, and cannot enter Varnimyr Challenge  Mode.
Challenge  Mode Battle Start
  For dungeons for 3~4 players, the  battle will start when all party members are in the waiting room,  For dungeons for 4~8 players, all players  will enter together and fight in the same space.  Other characters that started  the challenge together that’s not in the striker party cannot be invited to the  striker party during the challenge. But when a party member somehow exits from  the party, then that party member can be invited again provided that every  striker party member is not playing the dungeon.  Party Buff/Heal/Item/Special  effects will only apply to your current party and the debuff applied to the  boss will be shared to all striker party members.  When the time limit ends, the  dungeon will automatically be forfeited and will start from the first boss of  each dungeon when challenging again. (You will be exited from the dungeon if  it’s during the dungeon.)  The party leader can forfeit  the challenge when there’s time remaining and when every party member agrees  through the pop-up window, they can forfeit the challenge.
Raid  and Raid Challenge Mode System Changes
  Raid and Raid Challenge Mode  Reset time is changed from Every Tuesday 23:00 ~ Wednesday 00:10 to Every  Tuesday 23:50 ~ Wednesday 00:10. Playtime will end at Tuesday 23:50.  Raid Ranking will be removed  from the ranking boards available at boards and Camp NPCs. Raid Ranking Rewards  for after the 04/05 Raid Clearance Update will not be distributed.
Reward  Item
  You can obtain ‘Annihilating Soul Aura’ as a reward  every week 1 time by clearing the last stage per dungeon. This item can be  exchanged with Pet: Annihilator Automata, Pruinaum Region Accessory Select Cube  and other various items through Camp: Aurora NPC, Asella.  Players may obtain the following  force skills as drops when clearing Altar of Invocation: Annihilator dungeon.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/064802ecdd21cc7311a36cedcad8228ff28a7bb7.jpg

★ Elrios Pass Season 4

Clear missions every day and receive various rewards  with the Elrios Pass Season 4 update!
  Season Pass will go on  for 12 weeks. Once the season ends, you will no longer be able to receive the  rewards.
  * Elrios Pass Season 4 will be from 2023/4/12  00:00 ~ 2023/7/4 23:59.

How  to Use Elrios Pass 
  Click on the Elrios Pass UI at  the top of the screen to enter.   Clear Daily/Weekly/Season missions to gain  Season Pass EXP. Achieve specific levels to obtain Normal (Free)/Premium  reward.Elrios  Pass Item Mall Item

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/c4216ec1bef2fc1d05999a4f74135326f504d555.jpg

 How to use Tenebrous Effect Select  Ticket 
  * Here are instructions on how to  use the Elrios Pass Season 4 reward, Tenebrous Effect Select Ticket.
  * What are Tenebrous Effect Select  Tickets? Tenebrous Effect Select Tickets allow you to imbue the max stat  of the desired Shadow Effect to your Tenebrous Equipment.

[olist]  Right-click on the Tenebrous  Equipment you want to imbue effects from the inventory.
    (Cannot be used on  equipment where the Shadow Effects have not been identified.)  Select and click the line to  imbue Shadow Effect (◆, ◆◆, ◆◆◆). (You can only  select 1 line.)  After  selecting the wanted Shadow Effect, click ‘Imbue’.[/olist]

Heya adventurers! The Christmas Season is going to be extremely jam-packed with events and even more rewards! In addition to jolly, merry making, we’re launching the new Hair Dye System to elevate your style and individuality further! There’s also a limited-time event where you can upgrade your Raid weapons to be even stronger, but you’ll have to find out how by tuning in! And as always, don’t forget to take a peek at the wonderful new things we have at the Item Mall for this week!

 

Hair Dye System Update Event

There are more ways to customize your look! Change the color of your locks and that’s one more way to distinguish yourself among the rest!


 Choose between a [Cobo] Hair Color Palette (Daily) or a [Cobo] Hair Color Palette (Natural) when you clear dungeons within your level range 5 time!
 And when you clear dungeons within your level range 15 times, you get to choose a free hair cube!
 And when you dye your hair once you get 1 more [Cobo] Hair Color Palette (Daily) or a [Cobo] Hair Color Palette (Natural)!

 

Powerful Punch Master Events

Once you’ve reached 99, the higher your CP is the better the rewards! Reach certain CP milestones and haul the goodies you deserve!


 Achieve certain Combat Power (CP) milestones to gain rewards like: [Ariel] Fighter Potions, [Ariel] Sage’s Magic Stones, [Ariel] Stamina Potions, and so much more! The highest CP you can achieve for the event is 1,500,000 CP!
 Test out your power by clearing a series of quests to get even better rewards like: [Cobo] Sanctus Seraphim Costume Full Set (30 Days) Cube, [Cobo] +9 Flames of Judgement – Demonic Weapon Cube, [Cobo] Varnimyr Raid Accessory Select Cube, titles, amulets, and so much more!

 

Christmas Event

Tis the season to decorate your homes for the holidays! The best part? You’ll get ’em for free!


 Just login for 10 accumulative minutes every day to get 3 [Cobo] Christmas Tree Ornament Lights!
 But when you login on the 24th and the 25th, get the special [Cobo] Colorful Christmas Tree Ornament Lights. Get 15 on each day!
 After you’ve collected enough Ornament Lights, exchange them through Ariel for Holiday themed furniture! The [Cobo] Colorful Christmas Tree Ornament Lights can get you awesome stuff like: Spectral Amethysts, Tenebrous Aura, and more!
 Plus, there’s more reason to log in on the 24th and the 25th! Enjoy 2x EXP on the 24th, and 2x Drop Rate on the 25th!

 

Raid Weapon Upgrade Event

Are you level 99 and want to upgrade your weapon? Tune in this week, to find out more!

 

Item Mall Goodies

Battle the chill in the air with a nice warm cup o’ joe! Plus, it doesn’t hurt to dress warmly with the Winter Cafe Costume Set!

https://i.imgur.com/cda2lA3.jpg
 

To celebrate, the launch of the Hair Dye System, we’re bringing a bunch of popular hairstyles back so you can try and recolor them to suit your personality! Get a load of these returning favorites!

Featured: Core Black Swimwear Hair, Blossom Bird Hair, Abandoned Nobility Hair, and Tropical Solar Hair.

https://i.imgur.com/pXydVRE.jpg

Heya adventurers! Get ready to fill your inventories once again with awesome daily rewards: Everyone’s favorite Attendance Event is back! The best part? You can’t miss a day! So, stay tuned and prepare yourselves for TONS of wonderful freebies! And as always, we have an epic new Ice Burner set to enhance your power and your aesthetics! Show the fruits of your hard work under your El Master! Watch out for it at the Item Mall this week!

Stamp, Stamp Attendance Event

Now, here’s an event you’ll be anticipating daily! Stuff your bags and banks with EPIC every day rewards to keep you stocked up for a long time!


 Just login everyday for 30 minutes to get the reward on the Attendance UI! It’s really THAT simple!
 Don’t you worry about missing a day! Join our weekend ticket event and get Stamps, Stamp Attendance Tickets so you can guarantee that you’ll get any rewards that you’ve missed!
 And, if you have extra Stamps, Stamp Attendance Tickets you can exchange them through Ariel to cop some extra rewards!


Item Mall Goodies

You’ve completed your training with the El Masters and you’ve become stronger than ever! Now, it’s time to set yourself apart by donning a powerful new Ice Burner Set: The Divinity of Seven Worlds! Complete ‘em when it comes out!

https://i.imgur.com/7jVOnMN.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Your Magical Dreams Come to Life! Get Ready for an EPIC Transformation!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/CpC6nFj.png

Heya adventurers! Elrios City needs defending and it’s up to you to get rid of the evil that lurks within! And you’ll be fighting demons and destroying demonic portals in the newest Event Dungeon! However, being hidden amongst the crowd is not enough – you gotta transform into something more magical! Dazzle your enemies and bring ‘em down with the power of love and justice with the latest Item Mall goodies featured this week! Don’t forget to check it out!

Elrios City Defense Event

When the sun sets, evil doers come out to wreak havoc across Elrios City. Don’t let them win! Enter the newest Event Dungeon and keep the city safe!


 Your 10 minutes of daily login will reward you with 2 [Cobo] Elrios City Map so you can help defeat more demons and get more reward!
 Clear Elrios City Defense once daily to get 30 [Cobo] Heart El Potion
 The best part? Get DOUBLE Heart El Pieces for the duration of the event so you can exchange them for Heart El Friends Costume Pieces faster!


Item Mall Goodies

You can’t fight crime if you ain’t cute! And there’s nothing cuter and more magical than a magical girl or boy! Get ready to transform into your most magical form with Heart El Magical Bright or Heart El Shining Change when they come out!

https://i.imgur.com/YKefbUU.jpg

https://i.imgur.com/UEcm5fT.jpg


That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/8f3188584556e09395a5a1834ebee02c92968eda.jpg

Heya adventurers! After all the housing excitement next week, it’s time to take a quick breather! That doesn’t mean we won’t have anything for this week, though! House party all day, house party all night! You think the excitement will stop but here’s part 2 of the fun!


 Try out how sweet your home life will be with the [Cobo] Housing Buff Trial Ticket! Just login daily for 10 minutes!

notes.title: Start Living Humbly (or Nobly) with Elsword’s Real Estate!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/NK28uiL.jpg

Heya adventurers! Tired of wandering of around aimlessly with no permanent place to stay or hangout? If you are, we have the greatest news for you! This week, Elrios is finally opening its real estate services so you can your own personal quarters to show off or just relax in! Stay for as short as 7 days to permanently owning your very own abode! Isn’t that just exciting? Watch out for it this week! Aside from that, we have new Laby stuff at the Item Mall that you should definitely check out plus a plethora of new real estate item and coveted plush furniture!

El House Event
Here’s another reason to rise to level 99! Only those with max level can get a house of their very own! And when you do, you can decorate them to your heart(h)’s content! And here’s how to get FREE furniture!

 During this event, you’ll randomly encounter a Butler Phoru in any dungeon within your level range. Defeat them and get [Cobo] Furniture Exchange Tickets and have Ariel exchange them for basic furnitures! It’s THAT simple!


Item Mall Goodies
Turn your basic living space into a den of luxury with the very first luxurious furniture set! Get the Nobility Set when it comes out!

https://i.imgur.com/vCygjxW.jpg

Don’t let her innocent demeanor fool you! Laby’s a tactical fighter that’s ready to take down evil doers in the most efficient manner! Don the Laby S.W.A.T. Costume Set soon!

https://i.imgur.com/Ot5C3rr.jpg

Take cover and take a breather! After all that tactical fighting, Laby needs to recoup and recover. Hide behind the safety of Laby S.W.A.T. Break Time Rest Motion soon!

https://i.imgur.com/oRIeJGC.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

Elrios City Run

Run through the whole of Elrios City avoiding obstacles to reach the end! An event-exclusive pet is waiting for you!

 Login for 10 minutes everyday to get 2 [Cobo] Downtown Elrios Café Coupon! You can use these to enter the event dungeon!
 Plus, every time you clear Elrios City, get ready to get 30 Sparkling Jelly!
 What’s even more awesome? Get x2 Dungeon Clear Rewards for the duration of the event!


Item Mall Goodies

Blend in with the crowd while you survey the city and its surroundings! Catch that mysterious creature while looking extra cool! Get the Hidden Crowd costume when it comes out!

https://i.imgur.com/AgxNV8G.jpg

notes.title: Eve & Add Receive EPIC Power with Master Class!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/IxBZcCt.jpg

Heya adventurers! It’s Eve & Add’s turn to become stronger! Let the Queen of Nasods and the Manipulator of Time & Space show you how to slay big baddies with their new skills!

Plus, you wouldn’t want to miss all the epic rewards that are waiting for you! And as always, don’t forget to take a peek at the Item Mall to see all the wonderful goodies we have for you this week!

Adrian Master Dungeon Events

Meet their maker! And by that we mean, let Nasod Queen Eve and the Mad Genius Add meet the Maker, himself! Plus, if you can beat his best Nasods you reap wonderful rewards!


 If you’re still not ready to take on Herbaon and Durenda, fret not! Just login for a good 20 minutes and you’ll get the [Cobo] Target Lock-On (14 Days) Title and Nasod Controller.
 But the brave heroes will get an extra 50 [Cobo] Nasod Aura Potions when they spar with Herbaon and Durenda!


Forward Jumping Event Wave 3

The Final Forward Jumping Event will be commencing this week! Don't miss your last chance to create a new and epic character and have them get all the boosts and rewards they can get their hands on!

Support for New Power 3

We won’t let you go without getting these wonderful rewards! And all you have to do are the following:

notes.title: Might and Magic Collides with Aisha and Chung’s Master Class Release!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/kikK0wt.jpg

Heya adventurers! If you’re fans of our OG Mage and OG Berserker, then this is the week you’ve all been waiting for! Chung and Aisha reach the pinnacle of power with Master Class and we want you to experience it!

If Aisha and Chung aren’t your characters, then why not make one? The second Character Creation Event will provide your new characters with items for a quick leveling up experience without the grind, so what are you waiting for? Time for some action!

And as always, don’t forget that we always have fun and exciting things at the Item Mall for y’all!

Denif Master Dungeon Events

You’ll be drowning in rewards when Denif’s done with you or – is it the other way around? No matter, win or lose rewards abound!

 You don’t even have to fight him! Just login for a good 20 minutes and you’ll get the Water Dragon Scale (14 Days) Title and Water Aura Arm Ornament!
 But the brave heroes will get an extra 50 [Cobo] Water Dragon Aura Potions when they spar with El Master Denif!


7 Steps to New Power Event

Aisha and Chung finally get the power they deserve! Make their enemies kneel as they unlock their true potential!

 Login for 10 minutes to get a [Cobo] Key to New Power for Aisha and Chung!
 This key will open any [Cobo] New Power Cube that you get from clearing dungeons 7 times! Easy-peasy!
 Plus, any left-over Keys of New Power can be exchanged for 10 [Luriel] Recovery Potions so none are wasted and more rewards go to you!


Item Mall Goodies

Laby is made more powerful with a new Ice Burner Set! Let Laby soar through the skies with her new Gold Falcon Ice Burner Set! Get ‘em when they come out!

https://i.imgur.com/Xz8a4u9.jpg

Ara’s looking like the sweetest doll but she’s no puppet you can control! Get the adorable Ara Stuffed Toy when it comes out!

https://i.imgur.com/ccSee9B.jpg

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: MASTER CLASS is Here! Prepare Yourself!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/FOzhF00.jpg

Heya adventurers! Get hyped because the power you seek is very close! New powers will be unlocked starting this week and we want you to be ready to receive it! TONS of rewards and PLENTY of exciting events are lined up so you better not miss a single day of what we have in store for you! As always, don’t forget to take a gander at the Item Mall for all the fun and awesome items coming out this week!

Forward Jumping Event
New characters get boosted UP – FAST! This is your chance to surpass old characters and quickly reach Master Class in the blink of an eye:

 All characters created through the special Character Creation prompt will have limitations that will be lifted after the event has ended.
 Clearing dungeons for Elsword to Ain will reward them with EPIC items to help them transition from one class to the next with ease!
 But don't fret! Laby characters will get the same items but for this girl, it’s completing level requirements!


Gaia Dungeon Event
Train with El Master Gaia in his awesome NEW dungeon and be rewarded graciously!
Login for 20 minutes and get the Hard as a Rock Title and Earth Aura Earrings.
And when you spar with Gaia once a day, you get 50 [Cobo] Earth Aura Potions!

Preparing for New Power
Train for EPIC weekly rewards to help you get stronger faster!

 Ara and Laby gets a Mark of New Power (7 Days) Title when they clear the new Master Dungeon in Normal or Hell mode 5 times!
 The same goes for the rest of the characters but they also get an extra [Ariel] Master Artifact EXP Potion!


Support for New Power
Daily rewards just for clearing dungeons? You betcha! Now go get ‘em!

 Clearing dungeons within your level range once will nab you 30 [Luriel] Refined Recovery Potions and a [Cobo] Mark of New Power – First Piece!
 Clear ‘em 3 times and you get 5 [Cobo] Fighter Potions and another [Cobo] Mark of New Power – First Piece!
 Exchange these first pieces through Ariel to get rewards such as [Luriel] Sage’s Magic Stones, [Cobo] El Tear Fragments, Medals, Manuals, and more!


7 Steps to New Power
You’re on your way to unlock new powers! We’ve got plenty of rewards to make sure you’re ready!

 Just 10 minutes of login time will reward you with a [Cobo] Key to New Power for Ara and Laby.
 You can use this key to open [Cobo] New Power Cube that you can get from clearing dungeons 7 times! It’s really that simple!
 Plus, any left-over Keys of New Power can be exchanged for 10 [Luriel] Recovery Potions!


Item Mall Goodies
Be as warm as a polar bear in this new winter ensemble that’s sure to keep to toasty for long periods of time! Plus, it helps that it adds to your cuteness appeal! Get the Wintering Polar Costume Set when it comes out!

https://i.imgur.com/35VUMQx.jpg

If you’re looking for something fun, unique, whimsical or all those 3 combined, we have just the thing for the Elswords of Elrios. This Ragdoll Costume Suit will satisfy your craving for uniqueness and cuteness!

Laby gets a new set of warm and cuddly costumes to keep her warm for days to come! Get the I Bear Snuggles/Cuddles or the Padded Hedgehog Costume soon!

notes.title: Join Elsword & the Gang for an Exciting New Year’s Celebration!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/b4caec6e93c6c11b017f846d096d661e19ed2044.jpg

Heya adventurers! Let's start the New Year with a bang and we have plenty of exciting events to make sure that your year ends and begins epicly! Fill your inventory with goodies for every Minute you stay logged in (Up to 10 Minutes!)! Then,  we’re getting you ready for a new power that’s coming soon so stay tuned! And as always, we’ve got new items at the Item Mall that we know you’ll love!

New Year’s Event
Countdown (and up) to Elrios’ best New Year’s celebration! These rewards are for one day ONLY so you better not miss it!

 On New Year’s Eve, login for 1 – 10 minutes and watch those rewards arrive one by one! Get elixirs, dungeon tickets, magic stones, and more!
 Then do it again on New Year’s Day!
 Also, it’s EXP X2 on New Year’s Eve and New Year’s Day.
 The best part? We have a New Year’s Day Sale to start your year right! It’ll be shame to miss these deals!


Mark of New Power
There’s a new power on the rise and we’re prepping you for it!

 Watch out for the mysterious new creature lurking in the dungeons! Defeat it and get a Mark of New Power. You can exchange that with Ariel for a Mark of Special Power!
 Once you’ve collected a few Marks of Special Power, you can get awesome rewards to help you on your adventures!
 10 Marks of Special Power will guarantee 1 Mark of Absolute Power. 10 of those will nab you 1 [Luriel] Armor Only Magic Amulet Lv. 9! How awesome is that?!


Item Mall Goodies

New eyes to match the new Ice Burner! These mystical sea eyes will mesmerize friends and foes alike. Launch an epic attack with just one look with the Nereid Eyes.

https://i.imgur.com/gHzZf2b.jpg

To the moon and beyond! Laby is ready to traverse the vastness of space with the superbly cute Space Moon Rabbit Costume Suit!

https://i.imgur.com/ubXYhhh.jpg

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: The Ghostly El Gang Prowls the Night, Because Halloween’s Upon Us NOW!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/0rTPEMT.jpg

Heya adventurers! Aren’t you super excited for Halloween? I know I am! So, this week will be a fun-filled spook-a-thon during the Halloween event with the El Search Party! Apart from that, we’ve also got a Balance Patch coming in for few characters so don’t forget to check that out as well. And as always, don’t forget to take a peek at the Item Mall for all the fun, new stuff this week!

Halloween Event
Get your ghost on and party like you’re see through! All treats, no tricks (well, maybe) this week with an awesome Halloween event! Don’t miss it!
• When you clear dungeons 3x every day, you’ll get 1 [Cobo] Halloween Ghost Coin and 20 [Cobo] Pumpkin Flavored Candy daily! 
• PLUS, a there’s also a fun mini-game to dabble in so you can get more Ghost Coins and Pumpkin Flavored Candies! 
• Collect enough Ghost Coins and you can exchange them for a bunch of cool consumables, tickets, and more! Including the very awesome [Luriel] Ghostly Pale Pajamas – Hallow!

Item Mall Goodies
One day you’re in, the next day you’re out! – Except if you’re part of the El Gang! Make fashion happen with a new costume set! Get the Elite Tailor Costume Set when it comes out!

https://i.imgur.com/CJRUaof.jpg

 FREE ENTRY to Secret/Heroic Dungeons and Elrianode Dungeons! Starting on Wednesday until the event ends!

notes.title: Elsword's Laby Gets Her 3rd Job Path
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/qTKQJ3r.jpg

The Eternal Night Takes Over the Adorable Brawler

Irvine, Calif., March 6, 2019 – KOG Games, a leading developer and publisher of popular free-to-play action MMORPGs, today released the 3rd Job Path, Rusty Child, for their newest, playable character, Laby (pronounced lab-ee). Check out the new trailer here.

Laby's excitement from entering a new world soon faded and was replaced by a feeling of discomfort. She could not shake the feeling, eventually leading her to make a mistake in the battlefield. Despite this, she was able to defeat the enemies with Nisha’s help. Bellonde, however, was injured in the process and his wounds were not healing immediately like hers. She finally realized where her feelings of discomfort were coming from. 

Trusting Nisha to take care of her, Laby gives all of her emotions to Nisha allowing her to become corporeal while Laby slowly fades away. To prevent Laby from disappearing, Nisha turned her into a mirror and promised to make this world a place just for Laby - where she can be happy like before. 

Rusty Child, Daydreamer, and Nisha Labyrinth; come to realize the nature of their existence... together. Until the day all light fades to nothing.

Dark path stans and Laby lovers unite! Today is the day you’ve all been waiting for! The gloom and doom of Nisha is upon us! An Exciting New Adventure and special rewards are available today, including:
Every 10 levels plus accomplishing specific tasks will give Laby plenty of rewards to keep her afloat as she explores her new world! Fill your inventories with rewards like: Accessories, Expansion Cubes, Potions, Mounts, a Mini Poco, and so much more!
Plus, get more consumable rewards daily like Sage’s Magic Stones, Elixirs, and Potions when you clear dungeons within her level range!

The Laby 3rd Job Path Event begins today and concludes on March 19 at 11:59 PDT.

Heya adventurers! There are tons of fantastic new events happening this week! Get ready for another character pre-event as we prepare for Laby’s newest and happiest path! Plus, get your wallets ready because we have the most awesome Premium Ice Burner Package Event happening this week too. If you love Ice Burner Popcorns events, you’ll definitely love this! You’d think that was it but there’s still more – more rewards and events!

The time to improve your weapons and equipment is now! – err, tomorrow – at the Enhancement Event! Become stronger, faster, and better at the start of the year! We also have an awesome Treasure Hunter event that guarantees you a reward whether you open the chest or not! And as always, there’s wonderful stuff at the Item Mall waiting for y’all tomorrow!

Laby 2nd Path Pre-Event
We know you’re super excited for the new path but it’s time to make a new Laby so she’ll be ready to kick some baddies’ butts (with a smile) as her newest path enters the picture soon.
You’ll get Lively Flowers for completing daily quests and chain quests with Laby. You can use these to get rewards such as [Luriel] Blessed Time and Space Scrolls, [Cobo] Twisted Time and Space Keys, [Luriel] Phoru Foot Stamps and more!

Premium Ice Burner Package Event
Get a chance to receive up to 200 Radiant Flower Ice Burners through this EPIC event! You just need Premium Ice Burner Tickets from the Premium Ice Burner Packages. So, don’t miss this chance to complete your Radiant Flower set!

Enhancement Event
New year, new strengths gained! We all want to get a little stronger and what better way to do that than an Enhancement Event! Go crazy and lineup at your favorite blacksmith spot!
Logging in daily for 20 minutes will reward you with [Cobo] Blessed Fluorite Ores! And there are other special login events where you need to login at specific dates. Don’t miss those too!
It’s our favorite Lucky Enhancement tickets once again! Get a Lucky Enhancement Equipment/Armor Cube when you login for 10 minutes. 
Enhance the amulet until it reaches +8 and above to get an equivalent Amulet which you can then use for your actual weapons! Isn’t that just ingenious? The fear of breaking your weapons is gone! 
Plus, get your K-Ching ready for a wonderful enhancement sale! This is your chance to snag ALL your enhancement essentials for less! 

Treasure Hunter Event
Instead of going Treasure Hunting, you’re going on a keyhole guessing journey! The treasure chest is here – but it has 10 keyholes! Can you guess which keyhole is the correct one to get yourself some sweet coins?
Get keys by completing Daily Key quests or spending 100 K-Ching in the Item Mall to receive 1 Key! 
Players who successfully open the chest will get coins which they can exchange for much better rewards such as Radiant Flower IBs, Sage’s Magic Stones, Wardrobe Tickets, Magic Amulets,  and more! The best part is, once the chest has been opened, it will reset and you get some of the rewards multiple times (others, just once)!
Players who fail to open the chest get a ticket which they can exchange for 5 Premium MP Potions, 10 Organic Apples, 10 Complete Recovery Potions, or 10 Red-Bean Sherbet.

Item Mall Goodies
Molly is the roundest and bounciest pet you’ll ever own! She may look like a dungeon monster but this precious creature will be your forever friend! Get your Molly when she comes out tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/1smsDhi.gif

Although Laby is the sweetest and happiest girl you’ll ever meet, get ready to bring out her evil side. Just aesthetically, though! Clothe Laby in her very own Archdevil Ice Burner Set because sometimes, evil is cute!

https://i.imgur.com/jDYOqxg.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Brace Yourself! A New Week Means TONS of New Updates and Events!

Heya adventurers! It’s time to brace yourselves again this week because we’ve got tons of exciting new updates! First up, the El Search Party has discovered another dungeon at the Demon Realm, journey with them and find out what manner of creatures roam the area and uncover what will happen in their journey! Speaking of the Demon Realm, we’re adding a Story Mode in the Raid Dungeon which requires less Combat Power! Now, you can learn the story with less stress and then you can just come back to deal with the real fight in Normal Mode if you wish!

Next up, it’s the start of PVP League Season 3! Ranks will reset and everyone will get a fresh start! Will you remain on top or will someone take your place? For this season’s PVP update, we have two new maps for you to enjoy your fights in! So queue up for a match to check them out!

Choose Your Reward Event
We’re giving plenty of rewards and you get to choose which one you’ll receive! From potions to amulets to magic stones, take your pick!
After clearing 2 dungeons within your level range, you can choose your reward for the day! Do that again the next day and choose another reward! It’s totes awesome!

Shadow Vein Event
The new dungeon brings new adventures and events which means tons of new rewards! 
Login for 20 minutes to get awesome items like [Cobo] Varnimyr Region Title Cube, [Cobo] Varnimyr Region Accessory Trial Cube, and Mystic Stone Fragments!

notes.title: Upcoming Quality of Life Changes (July 11th Update)
notes.content:
MORE CONVENIENT

[Free Skill Slot Medal/Quick Slot]
All characters’ b slot and quick slot expansion will be free.
* Transcendence Skill Slot will not be expanded for free but you can acquire it by clearing a quest or purchasing it from the ED Shop in the Item Mall.

[ED Shop Update]
ED Shop contains Skill Slot Medal (Transcendence), Adult Pet, Fetch Aura, Costumes per Character, and etc. will be sold.
* Items purchased from the ED Shop can be stored in the share bank but cannot be traded.

[NPC Reward Exchange Function Change]
When exchanging multiple Random items from an NPC, you can receive different items.


FASTER

[Beginning Section Improved]
Noah’s Lake field will disappear and Elder Town and Ruben Town will be directly connected via porta.
Quests related to Fields will either disappear or have their quest rewards and exp will be changed.
Elrios Guide will be changed to Contents Guide and can be searched by key words.
Required Level for Ereda Island and Quests will be changed to Lv.90.
Quests related to Luto Mode will require Lv.75.

[Skip Function Improved]
When a Lv.5 or higher character uses the Quest Skip function, they will receive 50% of the EXP and receive the reward item.
(However, ED will not be rewarded and some quests related to Secret/Heroic Dungeons will not be skippable.)
Recommended level for dungeons will be displayed on the dungeon select screen.

[Elrios Studio Quest Removed]
All quests related to Elrios Studio will be removed. (Players with already accepted quests can still complete it.)
Quests rewards like ‘High-Performance Nasod Megaphone’ and ‘Cobo Entertainment Studio’ can be purchased from the Item Mall using K-Ching or ED.
However, items purchased from the ED Shop will be tagged [Cobo] and cannot be traded.

[Mentor Quest Improved]
Mentor Quest requirement will be improved.

[El Resonance Quest Improved]
El Resonance Quests will be improved.

[Camilla’s Skill Quest Improved]
Camilla’s Intermediate/Advanced/Expert Manual quests will be improved.

[Stamina Improved!]
Stamina spent from all dungeons and fields will be reduced and Ereda Island no longer consumes stamina. 

[Old Character Inventory Expansion] 
All old characters with Inventories smaller than 8 x 5 will be expanded to 8 x 5. 

[Market Board ED Limit Increase] 
Market Board ED Limit will increase from 3 Billion ED to 5 Billion ED. 

[Share Bank Improvement] 
You can now deposit ED in share bank. (Limit 5 Billion ED depending on the player’s Bank Rank) 
Share Bank now has a sort function.

[Secret/Heroic Dungeon, Elrianode City, and El Tower Defense can be entered 1 time a day for free] 
Free Daily Entry will reset every midnight server time. 

[Secret Dungeon Tab] 
All Secret Dungeons will be moved to a Secret Dungeon tab. The Secret Dungeon tab will be opened at Lv.70. 

[Heroic Gear Improved] 
All Heroic Gears can no longer go below Heroic Rank Lv.10. 


MORE IMPROVEMENTS!
[Equipment Enhancement Safe to +8!)]
Equipment Enhance can no longer fail up to +8.
[Apocalypse Type – Void Weapon Cube can now be share banked.]
[As you clear Add’s Energy Fusion Theory Dungeon without getting the Weapon Drop, the chances of the weapon cube dropping will increase.] 
Even if you don’t pick-up the weapon cube, once it drops, the increased drop rate will reset.

[Epic PVP Quest Improved]
Required level for quest will become Lv.75 and the quest will become easier. 
When clearing an Epic PVP Quest, you will be given Camilla’s Sparring Equipment Cube (+8) as a reward.

[Character Slot Revamp] 
Avg. Item Level will be removed from the Character Info UI but will be replaced by Combat/Defense Power. 
Also, dungeon entry requirements will be changed from Item Level to Combat Power. 
You can now check the below options from the Stats window.
Some stats will be shown as % instead of numbers. 
(Example: Maximize 572 à Maximize 4%)

[Item Revamp]
Equipment set effect from beginning leveling part will be removed. (lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded), Magic Stone Enchant Socket numbers will increase depending on the level. 
Depending on the Rank of Lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded, will be provided more random effects.
Specialization A & B will be removed and the A & B options will be changed.

[If Specialization A & B is a fixed effect]
Critical Chance, Maximize % 
Certain Set Effects or Title Effects will be changed.

[If Specialization A & B is a random option or a socket effect]
You can change to the below effect from Ariel. 
* Critical Chance, Add Damage, Maximize, Add Damage, Attack Speed, Damage Reduction, MP Gain (Attack), MP Gain (Attacked)
Specific Skill Damage Increase effect will no longer appear from equipment. 
However, effects that existed before this change will remain and all new equipment will have ‘All Skill Damage Increase’ option.

[Old Ice Burner Improvement]
Old Ice Burners will no longer require phoru footstamps to trade. You can now freely trade all Ice Burners without seals.

For more details on all the changes happening with the 7/11 update, please visit our website here.

notes.title: New Guild Expeditions and Permanent Daily Rewards are Coming At You!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/oEACopF.jpg

Heya adventurers! We’ve got big things coming tomorrow! Tons of exciting changes and fun events that we know you’ll go crazy for are happening this week so strap in and read on! First up, we have the awesome new Guild Revamp. We’ve added something called Guild Expeditions to make your guilding experience a tad more exciting. We’ve also added the use of Guild Banners because we want your Guild to Represent! Getting excited yet? You can find out more when it comes out. Next is something totally exciting because it involves rewards and who doesn’t like rewards?! We’ve just made Daily Login Rewards permanent addition to the game! That’s right, just log-in, spend time in game, and claim your rewards! Returning users will also get a special set of rewards when they come back, and the best part is, they can also get the Regular player set of rewards! This is the perfect time for you or your friends to return!  

Then we have another Elrios World Travel event! Same simple mechanics but totally different epic rewards! And lastly, we have balanced some of the characters once again for your enjoyment! Heya adventurers! What are you up to? We hope you have lots of time to spare because this is going to be a fun-filled week! First, we’ve got an exciting new event dungeon that’ll keep you coming back for more! We’ve also made more rebalances to select characters that you’ll be able to see and test out tomorrow! 

Combo Video Submissions for Raven, Eve, and Chung are about to end but you still have a bit of time to submit them until midnight tonight, if you haven’t yet! Velder Academy Athletic Meet
Don’t forget to warm up for this fun and exciting event dungeon we have for you! Destroy all the La-Z viruses and clear the field of all infections by beating them to a pulp! You’ll get awesome rewards when you do!

Heya adventurers! We’ve got an awesome and jam-packed week ahead of us starting with Elsword’s 7th Anniversary Celebration! Join us in this wonderful event or you’ll miss out big time on a week of boosts, and TONS of awesome giveaway! Then here’s some good news for the raiders this week – Drabaki, The Serpent of the Mountain, is wreaking havoc in the lands of Elrios. Get ready to battle and test your strength against this great beast and see how you fare! Fashionistas rejoice and sing your hallelujahs because accessory looks can now be overridden with looks that match your unique style! Complete a streamlined look but keep your stats in this newest Magic Wardrobe update coming in tomorrow! Never choose between form and function again, you can have both! And as always there’s new stuff at the Item Mall just for you!

Elsword 7th Anniversary Event
Join us as we celebrate 7 years of Elsword! That’s right, our beloved game turns 7 and we’re bringing TONS of boosts and epic rewards that are only available during this time! Don’t miss out!
All characters level 10 and up will get an exclusive sit motion! The Ely’lywood Blue Carpet! Make sure to login all of your characters for ONLY 10 minutes so they can get it!
Next, 30 minutes of accumulative login time will give you a [Cobo] Anniversary Trial Cube that contains tons of useful consumables and a 1 Day 7 Year Anniversary Skill Cut In!
Want a permanent skill cut-in though? Easy-peasy! Collect Anniversary stamps by logging in for an accumulated time of 30 mins and once you have enough, exchange them via Ariel for different types of cubes that include the permanent 7 Year Anniversary Skill Cut-in!

Drabaki Event
Meet the corrupted warden of darkness at Fahrmann’s Peak. Stop the beast from wreaking havoc and prove yourself in the rankings! Are you deserving of this great monster’s bounty?
20 minutes of accumulative connection for characters level 99 will get 1 [Cobo] Twisted Time and Space Key so they can enter and fight!

1-on-1 With Pie
Ever wanted to ask some of your favorite GMs a question, such as who their favorite Elsword NPC is, their favorite dungeon to run, or the one food they wouldn’t touch with a 10-foot pole? See you later today, and then come back tomorrow to interview GM Srirachalada, and then again on Thursday, leading up to the weekly GM Livestream on Friday!

notes.title: Become the Coolest Jet-setter in Elrios and Travel the World Elsword-style!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/yffXOis.jpg

Heya adventurers! How are you this fine day? We’ve got a jam-packed week for you so get ready for tons of fun events and awesome rewards! First up, we have a Balance update coming up, get ready for tiny tweaks that make a big impact on your skills, and don’t forget to test them out as well! Next, we have an event perfect for all the travelers out there – pair it up with tons of amazing rewards and you’ll be going places non-stop! And lastly, it’s time to get your winning character combos ready! Show the world what you can do because you have a chance to win TONS of K-Ching! And as always, don’t forget to take a peek at the Item Mall for new stuff and things! All these and more, tomorrow!

Balance Patch Event
Newly rebalanced skills bring for a more streamlined gaming experience and we bring a very simple but fun event with this important patch!
Clear dungeons daily up to three times and get these rewards: [Cobo] Recovery Potions, [Cobo] EXP Boost Medal 50% (7 Days), [Cobo] Stamina Potions, and [Cobo] Mana Elixir! How’s that for easy questing?
And if that’s not simple enough, we’re having an attendance event where all you need to do is login for 20 mins to get epic rewards!

Elrios World Travels
Become the coolest jet-setter in all of Elrios! Choose your destination for the day and complete the quests to get awesome rewards including an extra awesome event-exclusive sit-motion!
Complete your destination quests for the day and get Elrios Travel Coins!
Use the coins to exchange them with Ariel for the following costume suits: Yukata, Martial Arts, and Water Spirit! 
You can also exchange just 1 Elrios Travel Coin for 5 Phoru Airline Beverages! Happy travels~

Combo Video Contest
Showoff your character’s greatest moves and become a combo master! Let out your creativity and mesmerize the audience with your character’s impeccable techniques. And, if enough people are absolutely stunned by your flawless feats, they can vote for it and you might get a chance to win grand prizes! Be sure to check it out tomorrow!

Item Mall Goodies
You won’t need to ask your father to take you to the city to see a marching band! Dress up like in you’re in one and let out beautiful beats with the Elrios Marching Band Costume Set tomorrow! 

https://i.imgur.com/X4lSrFW.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Bring Order Back to the Velder Academy Library and Check Out New Sparring Features!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/2Jb3k9o.jpg

Heya adventurers! How are y’all doing? Have you reached the peak of 3rd Job goodness? If not, don’t worry, you’ll reach it soon! Just hang tight and keep leveling. This week, we have TONS of new improvements in our Sparring System like Free Training improvements where you can now check for damage info, choose map options, choose a new NPC, and many more! We’ve also added Spectator Mode where a maximum of 4 spectators can watch and observe a match! Then there’s also a new El Resonance feature where you can add an El Resonance page with a completely different build! How awesome is that?

Apart from these improvements, there’s a new event dungeon as well where you can beat those pesky Phorus and teach Professor Banthus a lesson! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the awesome goodies we have in store for you! All these and more, tomorrow!

Love, Love Academy Event
Deep within the shelf-lined halls of the prestigious Velder Academy’s Library lies a Suspicious(?) Book. Phoru Students and Professor Banthus are wreaking havoc just to get it. Stop the destruction and reap the rewards!
Get 2 [Cobo] Velder Academy Library Card when you login for 10 minutes! Get inside that library and collect Suspicious(?) Pages!
Exchange your Suspicious(?) Pages with Ariel and if you’ve collected enough you can get epic rewards like idle motions, skill cut-ins and more!

Item Mall Goodies
Don’t just stand around looking awkward, do something fun! Like take a selfie! Selfie 101 is a new idle motion that’s sure to catch everyone’s attention!

https://i.imgur.com/kmIbUhr.gif

https://i.imgur.com/DdtYneO.gif

Dish out powerful skills but don’t forget you’re still just a youth in spring! Show how epic damage dealing makes your heart go ‘doki-doki’! Fluttering Heart Skill Cut-In comes out tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/kA7bxsu.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: More 3rd Job Goodness Coming at You with Daily Rewards – Don’t Miss It!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/6yTQj99.jpg

Heya adventurers, this week we have another exciting event for you! We’re bringing you a very simple way to earn rewards and maximize your 3rd Job status! Costumes, potions, tickets, and more are waiting for you this week, so don’t miss the fun and the epic rewards! And don’t forget we have wonderful items at the Item Mall, so don’t forget to check it out!

3rd Job Finale – Part 3 & 4
Earn epic rewards daily with these exciting events! Level up faster, look spiffier, run dungeons and more with a plethora of rewards just for you!
The 3rd Part of the Finale has to do with clearing dungeons within your level range a few times. Completion of the condition will give you [Cobo] Complete Recovery Potion x10 for the first time, [Cobo] 50% EXP Boost Medal x1 for the second time, and [Cobo] Stamina Potion and [Cobo] Mana Elixir for the third time! So, what are you waiting for, sweep those dungeons clean!
Part 4 is a fantastic daily attendance event that lasts until April 1st. Curious to know what you’ll get? You’ll find out soon!
You’d think that’s all we have, but watch out in the coming days because we still have more surprises up our sleeves!

Item Mall Goodies
Fly like the monkey-king and be one with the clouds! Control the weather and smash your foes with great ease! Get on a fluffy Somi tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/6sHPJtH.gif
https://i.imgur.com/DWjEMj8.gif

notes.title: 3rd Job Madness Brings Endless Fun, Amazing Boosts, and Epic Rewards!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Fum7ZGD.jpg

Heya adventurers! How are y’all doing? We hope you’re still pumped and still have that 3rd job high because we’ve got so much in store for you now that you’re all very familiar with your favorite 3rd Job classes! This week, you can test out your characters and match up against other players with the PVP Revamp now that PVP Season 6 begins tomorrow! We’ve also got an awesome Enhancement Event to help you make your epic equips more awesome! And don’t forget, there are always new things at the Item Mall we can’t wait for you to get your hands on!

PVP Revamp + Season 6
It’s time to oil your gears once more because PVP Season 6 begins tomorrow! Ranks have been reset and you may just become the top dog this time around!
Login for 10 minutes to receive a [Cobo] +10 Sparring Equipment Cube and a [Cobo] PVP Essential Items Cube (15 Days) which contains rings and a magic necklace!
Plus, earn milestone rewards by completing individual and guild PVP!

Enhancement Event
Hold on to your hats because another round of enhancement event awesomeness is here! Be sure not to miss it, though, because this awesome event is only for 1 day tomorrow!
Login for an accumulative time of 10 mins to receive 2 [Cobo] Blessed Fluorite Ore, 2 [Cobo] Blessed Restoration Scroll, and 2 El’s Hammer!
Most exciting of all, for one day only, all enhancement aid requirements will be reduced to 1 when enhancing from level 8 to 13!

Elsword Amazon Shop Is Now Open!
https://i.imgur.com/T9aFUM9.jpg
Check out the awesome items we have in store for you! This Elsword swag is not only fun but very well-made and in high demand. All these items all waiting to be purchased and just a click away!

More items will be added soon, but supplies are limited, so grab them now while they’re still hot! Visit our website to see all the goodies on sale!

Item Mall Goodies
Take to the streets and turn it into your runway! Flaunt this fashionable set and garner the stares of friends and enemies alike! The Street Star Costume Set comes out tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/CuG6IdL.jpg

Complement your Street Star ensemble with a pair of heart-shaped tinted sunglasses to match! This accessory is sold separately.

https://i.imgur.com/PhZL0zG.jpg

That’s all for now folks~

notes.title: Darkness and Destruction Rules the Path of the Corrupt: 3rd Job – 3rd Path is Here!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/eTzOr3u.jpg

Heya adventurers, fans of the dark path will be howling in joy this week! Whether you’re a Dark El user or a Henir fanatic, we know this update will make your shadowy heart giddy so don’t forget to participate in the events! 

3rd Job – 3rd Path Events
This is the last of the spectacular 3rd Job events that you wouldn’t want to miss! The period to reach the pinnacle of 3rd Job -3rd Path power in the shortest amount of time is now! 
Don’t forget, just like before, each quest in the chain quest you complete will reward you with extremely useful items, costumes, accessories, and more!
Get a Topiary of Transformation (15 Days) and (Permanent) when you complete Quest 2 and 20 respectively!

GM Livestream Today
The GMs will be hosting a special livestream today that will have exciting news too big to tell you in this blog, so if you want to be one of the first people to know what is headed your way, you won’t want to miss this Livestream! Livestream starts at 5 PM PST / 8 PM EST on our Elsword Twitch Channel. See you then!

https://i.imgur.com/lP5jGHW.jpg

Item Mall Goodies
Fly like a butterfly, and sting like a… butterfly? Sure, why not! This elegant Mariposa Set will make the calmest friend you have convulse in envy. Show off and slay foes while donning giant butterfly wings! 

https://i.imgur.com/jilSFmq.jpg

And if you just want those piercing Mariposa Eyes, you can buy it separately! Stun your enemies with a powerful glance!

https://i.imgur.com/DeU5yAG.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: The 3rd Path Opens the Road to Greatness! It’s Prep Time Again!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/86pVEeL.jpg

Heya adventurers! How y’all doing today? As you may have read in the title, 3rd Jobs for 3rd Paths Preparation Event (including 4th Path for Rose) is just a few hours away! It’s time to prep once again for the last time if you’re ready to transform because we are so ready! And as always, don’t forget that we have new stuff and thangs at the Item Mall that guarantees an Olympic gold medal! Check these out and more tomorrow!

Openbucks Promo
Still on the fence about purchasing K-Ching? This may be the promo you need to get you started! From February 21 to 27, 2018 players who load up using Gift cards from CVS, Subway, and Dollar General will get 20% BONUS K-Ching! Don’t miss it!

3rd Job-3rd Path Pre-Event
Get your 3rd Path characters ready because it’s their turn to have an epic transformation! Events, rewards, and more await!
Characters you selected to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! You only have to do half the job of leveling that character up!
Characters who achieve Lvl 70 during the event will get the Book of Transcendence: God’s Will to bypass quests and requirements so you can Transcend in no time!
When you reach level 90, you’ll get a Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon to deal an even mightier blow! This weapon alone makes it all worth it!
And there’s so much more than you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the juicy details!
Item Mall Goodies
Go for gold and outmaneuver your enemies on ice with the new Frozen Edge Costume Suit. Perform pirouettes and ace your landings with the motion that comes with the package!

https://i.imgur.com/ZgMbiOP.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Show Your Burning Passion Because Love Is in The Air This Week!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/1Md6tp7.jpg

Heya adventurers! This week we show our love to you with an awesome event that’ll grow your heart 3 sizes! So, watch out for a fun-filled day full of love tomorrow! And don’t forget our awesome Sweepstakes Event with TONS of epic prizes for players of all regions. The more playtime hours you accumulate, the more entries you get for a chance to win 15,000 K-Ching! 

In case, you don’t already know the New & Returning Characters Event is back at it again with boosts and rewards. Whether you’re a returning character or a player making a new character, we’ve got something to help you reach third jobs quickly! And if you have some K-Ching to spend, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall! There’s always something new and fun for everyone!

Valentine’s Day Event
Here’s a simple but sweet event for you to do on Valentine’s day when you’ve got no date! But of course, you can also do this together with your date!
Get [Cobo] Sweet Chocolates every 2 times you use your Quick Slot items!
Get your [Cobo] Couple Rings and show the world that you’re the best pair! Just clear 10 dungeons within your level!
All this and more tomorrow!

Item Mall Goodies
When the cold never really bothered you in the slightest, flaunt these Shining Snowy Accessories in front of your friends! Available tomorrow!

notes.title: The Second Ultimate Path Opens! Start Your Ascend to Greatness Tomorrow!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Zc8ygPS.jpg

Heya adventurers, tomorrow is the big day! Are you ready?! Because we are so pumped for everything that will happen tomorrow! We have plenty of events and TONS of awesome rewards for everyone so you really shouldn’t miss the 3rd job-2nd path launch! We also have something for new and returning characters so you can catch up and reach 3rd Jobs as fast as you can! And as always don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for new stuff!

3rd Job Events
Feel the rush of new-found powers once more! Unlock 2nd Path’s 3rd Job and reach the pinnacle of might and magic! Fantastic rewards are waiting just by logging in for 10 minutes and doing quests!
Only need a few more levels to get to 3rd jobs? We got you, fam! Login for 10 minutes (per account) and you’ll get not 1, not 3, not even 5, but 10 Philosopher’s Scroll!
If you want a permanent accessory, this event has got the thing for you! Just complete the chain quest and you’ll get a Topiary of Growth!
After reaching 3rd Jobs, head right on to the dungeons to test out your newly unlocked powers! You’ll even get rewarded for it!

New & Returning Characters
Whether you want to start from scratch, you’re completely new to the game, or want to continue your epic journey, we’ve got just the thing to help you out!
1st and 2nd Class Advance Tickets are FREE in the Item Mall during this time! 
Awesome chain quests for both New and Returning characters are available and will reward you big time!

Facebook
Don’t forget to check out our Facebook page to be the first to know about news, announcements, events, and more! Follow us!

Item Mall Goodies
No one is as sweet as the boy or girl who dresses up as a chocolate maker! Get the Chocolatier Costume and start showing off your sweet side tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/0Qm6jLz.jpg

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Get Ready for Another Round of Extreme 2nd Path Prepping!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/VQYL4E9.jpg

Heya adventurers! Guess what? 3rd Job 2nd Path is coming very, very soon and so we have another round of extreme prepping just for you! It’s time to hype yourself up and get ready! Before that though, let us remind you that you only have until next week to complete your attendance checks. Don’t miss out on another day so you can get more rewards by accumulating login days and logging on the last Saturday of this event! And as always, we’ve got an awesome new costume suit coming at the Item Mall. Don’t forget to check these out and more tomorrow!

3rd Job – 2nd Path Pre-Event
It’s time to once again level up like there’s no tomorrow! Items, boosts, and extra special events line up an exciting pre-event so you better not miss it!
First up, the character you selected to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! You only have to do half the job of leveling that character up!
Characters who achieve Lvl 70 during the event will get the Book of Transcendence: God’s Will to bypass quests and requirements so you can Transcend in no time!
When you reach level 90, you’ll get a Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon to deal an even mightier blow! Who can resist such rewards?! Not me, that’s for sure!
And there’s so much more that you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the juicy details!
Item Mall Goodies

Whether you want to look adorable while keeping warm or you want to have a tactical advantage on your enemies from the freezing cold, this Padded Hedgehog Coat Costume Suit has got your back! Fight for warmth tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/tYqb5Q0.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Raise Your Hands if You’re Here! We’re Taking Attendance at the Start of the Year!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/O3x7ZXv.jpg

Heya adventurers! How are you all starting your year? Got any gaming resolutions you want to accomplish? We can help with that! The start of the year brings so many new things and we want you to be present at all of them so we’re taking a daily attendance starting tomorrow! But of course, we’ll shower you with TONS of free stuff that will help you out through your journey to become strong! How exciting! And as always, there’s a cool new item at the Item Mall you can check out tomorrow!

Mystery Attendance Event
Don’t miss out on this extremely simple event that rewards you with something special every day!
Log-in for an accumulated time of 20 minutes using whichever character. Open up the Attendance UI and click on the day to get your random reward! 
You get a fixed reward every Saturday! 
There are also special rewards when you’ve logged in for 3, 7, and 14 days!

Item Mall Goodies
Cure the disease of a bad fashion day with the Elrios Medical Team Costumes for the El Search Party! You’ll always be ready for action with this wonderful set! Get them tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/Y5YqUl5.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/jUGa5u4.jpg 

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

https://i.imgur.com/jv8bkRO.jpg

Heya adventurers! How were your holiday celebrations? We hope you’re having fun with our events and the 3rd Jobs as much as we are! There’s so much happening this time of year and it gets us really excited, but there’s more coming in this week. From Christmas Eve and entering into the New Year, we have got covered and you’ll never get bored this winter! Don’t forget to login every day because you’ll never know when awesome rewards or boosts are going to suddenly popup! And of course, don’t forget to check out the wonderful Item Mall for limited time holiday sales!

New Year’s Event
We want you to start the new year with a bang so we’re preparing awesome things for you! On January 1st, 2018, this fantastic one-day event will be the perfect way to start your year strong!
DOUBLE EXP & DOUBLE DROP RATES for the whole day! Time to reach that 3rd Job status, fam!
Get 1 [Cobo] Stamina Potion when you login for 1 minute! Run dungeons to your heart’s content!
Clear Special Dungeon quests for extra special additional rewards!
And lastly, clearing any dungeon within your level range will give you 2 [Cobo] Sage’s Magic Stone!

Item Mall Goodies
Don’t forget to check the Item Mall for extra special package deals and steals! You just might complete your White Dragon: Servius Ice Burner Set in no time!

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Elsword Launches Biggest Update of the Year, 3rd Job 1st Path Update
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/i6tdO2w.jpg

KOG Games Begins the First of Three Large Updates

The highly anticipated 3rd Job First Path Update is here! This is the first of 3 updates that will feature 37 new Job classes in total; each update will usher in a new Job for every character for each Line.

In addition, the following features are debuting today:

One new dungeon: Forgotten Elrian Sanctum
First and second Job Advance items are free
Visual Update – Every Character (except Rose and Ain) have had their feet and hands resized for aesthetic improvement
In-game Prizes, Playtime Sweepstakes, Snowball Games, 2X’s EXP in PvP Arena and More!

To learn more about Elsword please visit www.elsword.com and keep watching the official Facebook page here. 

Play Your Manga!

notes.title: This Christmas, We’re Giving Everyone the Gift of Ultimate Power, Fun Mini-Games, and More!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/HKBTt3p.jpg

Heya adventurers! Christmas is just around the corner (we’re very excited!) and so we’ve guaranteed to make your Holidays extra special by bringing out the big guns! Are you as hyped up for 3rd jobs as we are? Because we totally are! A plethora of awesome rewards await you and a new skill system will unlock so you can tinker with it! But that’s not the only thing you can look forward to because we have tons of other amazing events perfect for the Holidays! Like the PVP Pre-Season Events, Christmas Events and so much more! Don’t forget to invite back friends who used to play Elsword or friends you want to introduce Elsword to because we have something extra special for them! And of course, holidays in Elsword would be incomplete without something new and awesome at the Item Mall! Don’t forget to check these out and more tomorrow!

3rd Job Events
The biggest and most awaited update in the history of updates is here! Elsword and the Gang break limits to unlock 3rd jobs and with it come fantastic rewards through quest completions or even just by logging in for 10 minutes!
Only need a few more levels to get to 3rd jobs? We got you, fam! Login for 10 minutes (per account) and you’ll get not 1, not 3, not even 5, but 10 Philosopher’s Scroll! 
If you want a permanent accessory, this event has got the thing for you! Just complete the chain quest and you’ll get a Topiary of Faith!
After reaching 3rd Jobs, head right on to the dungeons to test out your newly unlocked powers! You’ll even get rewarded for it!

Christmas Events 
Throw the Dice: Elriopoly!
Go around the board and get rare rewards after your Item Mall shopping spree! Every 100 K-Ching spent will give you 1 Dice Roll that automatically goes to your Elriopoly UI! 
Phoru Snowball Game! 
A winter mini-game that guarantees TONS of fun as you try to accumulate points for certain rewards! Hit multiple targets at once for massive points! 

PVP Pre-Season Event
We’re making your PVP more fun before the new season starts with these awesome events!
Get 2X EXP and AP when you win Arena matches!
Encounter more Epic NPCs!
Get a book that contains TONS of titles when you login for 10 minutes!

Item Mall Goodies
Dress up for the festivities in a luxurious ensemble that’s posh and fun at the same time! Get the Christmas Velvet Suits and Dresses tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/3hhYysZ.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all

notes.title: This Winter Season, We’re Bringing the Heat with Exciting Events and Cool Contests!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Zraq7qY.jpg

Heya adventurers, it’s chill time again this week but that’s because we’re getting ready for something extremely big and super exciting! If you’re wondering what it could be, you’ll just have to wait for next week! But don’t get completely bummed out since we have tons of events going on right now! If you don’t already know we have an on-going in-game event that prepares our heroes for the upcoming third job. This is an event you don’t want to miss because of its insane boosts (like having half of your EXP bar filled every time you level up) and epic rewards! Then, we have 2 very simple Facebook events that will give you the chance to win TONS of K-Ching, perfect for your in-game holiday shopping! You can check them out and join here: Chibi ALL the Jobs and It’s the Most Wonderful Time of the Year – To Level! And as always, we have new stuff at the Item Mall so don’t forget to check it out!

Item Mall Goodies
This lovely winter ensemble makes its way to you just in time for your freezing winter dates! Guaranteed to not make you look like a bundle of potatoes the Lovely Winter Costume will keep you fashionably warm!

https://i.imgur.com/UkBgy33.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: We’re Preparing You for Our Biggest and Best Update Yet! 3rd Jobs Are Coming Very Soon!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/KXaGd9Q.jpg

Heya adventurers! We’re feeling immense powers looming over the not-so-distant lands and soon it will be yours! You just have to be patient, because great things are worth the wait, after all. However, since we’re so hyped up about it, here’s an overview of what will happen: Your characters will get the most awesome transformation you can imagine complete with the best skills you have ever laid eyes upon! For that to happen, we have to get you all prepped up that’s there will be tons of events and loads of rewards to boost you to 99 in no time! On top of that, we’re bringing you another much the anticipated update of trade improvements and ED limits! You can finally become the savvy business person you’ve always wanted to be in Elrios! And as always, the Item Mall has some wonderful new stuff for you to check out! Don’t miss these updates and more tomorrow!

3rd Job Pre-Event
Now’s your chance to level up like a madman! We’ve got special events and boosts to make sure you reach level 99 before 3rd jobs roll in!
First up, your selected character to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! All you have to do is half the job of leveling that character up! 
Characters who achieve Transcendence during the event will get Book of Transcendence to bypass quests and requirements! So convenient!
When you reach level 90, you’ll get a Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon to deal an even mightier blow! Who can resist rewards?! No one!
And there’s so much more that you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the nitty-gritties!

Item Mall Goodies
It’s the most wonderful time for Ain! He’s getting two more epic Ice Burner sets to add to his wardrobe with the scholarly Miracle Alchemist Ice Burner Set and the firey Ignition Caligo Set. Collect them all tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/UZz5jRC.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Hop on to Elrios for Thanksgiving Week and Satisfy Your Gaming Hunger!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/9fEE7og.jpg

Heya adventurers! Thanksgiving is only a few days away and we’re so incredibly excited! But before that, we’ve got a fun pre-thanksgiving activity happening right now on our Facebook page and then we’ve got another exciting event tomorrow as well! You’d think that’s all of it but wait ‘til you see more awesome events and amazing deals coming to you this weekend! As for what they are, well, you’ll just have to find out! We have a very special Ice Burner set coming tomorrow so don’t forget to check out the Item Mall then!

Mystical Moon Rabbit Event
Hop on to this wonderful event that will shower you with TONS of rewards! 
10 minutes of accumulated login time once a week for two weeks will give you a Moon Rabbit Ticket which is one of the materials needed to craft an awesome costume!
Collect Moon Shards from doing difficulty-based (Normal, Hard, and Very Hard) quests and exchange them through Ariel for consumables. Better yet, you can also ask her to craft them for a wonderful Rabbit costume!

A Feast for a Chibi (Facebook Event) 
The people of Elrios are having a feast too. Show off your character and get a chance to win K-ching! How you ask? You can either draw or print out your favorite character in chibi form and take a picture of them next to a feast. Post it on the event thread in Facebook, check out other players’ feasts, and wait for the announcement. It’s totally easy! Head over to our Facebook Event Page to check out all of the details!

Item Mall Goodies
Four epic costume sets in one convenient Ice Burner! Get fabulous costume pieces from the Masquerade, Perkisas, Henir, and Archpriest Sets from the All-In-One Ice Burner tomorrow! 

https://i.imgur.com/RSy5GAp.jpg

https://i.imgur.com/22EHwkr.jpg

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Out of the Screens and Into the Game, We Have Something Special for Everyone!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/6WRG33x.jpg

Heya adventurers! How are you all doing? So, you know when Halloween ends the fun Halloween Dungeon will disappear soon, right? Wrong! We saw how much fun you’ve been having at the Hide and Seek Halloween Dungeon so we’re making it a permanent addition to our special dungeon lineups. How awesome is that? Now you can play graveyard hide-and-seek whenever you want! We also have another Balance Patch to bring some balance into your gaming life! It also comes with a very simple event so you get rewards for testing out the balanced skills! There will also be other game related updates and improvements coming in tomorrow! And as always, we have exciting new stuff at the Item Mall coming in tomorrow so stay tuned!

Elsword Anime Recap
Wasn’t that last Elsword episode uber exciting? At last the El Search Party has reached Lanox but Edel was much too busy with Town matters to help look for the priestesses. What would become of our red-haired knight and will Elsword and the gang be able to find the priestesses? You’ll have to watch to find out, it’s too exciting! Watch Episode 4 here!

Balance Patch Event
Test out the newly balanced Pvp and Dungeon skills and get rewarded for it!
Get 1 Balance Patch Experience Certificate when you Play 2 Matches in Arena or Clear 3 Dungeons Within Your Level Range! Do both Daily to get 1 Certificate for each completed task!
Get a Skill Tree Page Expansion when you collect all 14 Balance Patch Experience Certificates!
You can also exchange 1 Balance Patch Experience Certificate through Ariel for any of the following items: 10 [Cobo] Complete Recovery Potion, 2 [Cobo] Various Magic Stone Random Cube, or 1 [Cobo] Special Dungeon Entrance Ticket Selective Cube!

Item Mall Goodies
Play your Anime and experience Elrios in a whole new light! Relive the anime accurately with a costume and sit motion package that’s straight out of the anime ending credits! Get ‘em tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/0ldUEsZ.jpg

And a new stage backdrop has opened at Elrios Studios! Become the idol you were always meant to be! Get a Cobo Entertainment Studio at the Item Mall to unlock the Idol Studio backdrop tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/oCEOHfM.jpg

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

If not, you still have time to hustle so you don’t miss it! For those not in the know, our lovely Forum Moderators are having another sticker creation contest fit for the holidays and it already started! notes.title: Monsters Come Out of Hiding as Halloween Draws Near! Hang Out at the Cemetery and Party with its Dwellers!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/f3IiMpD.jpg

Heya adventurers! You only have a few days left to complete the rewards for the Heartbeat Attendance event! If you missed a few days here and there, we hope you at least still have the chance to get the accumulative log-in rewards, but make sure you don’t miss the remaining days! This week, we’re going to do what every adventure loving chaps like to do; hang out at the cemetery! But we swear it’s going to be extremely fun so don’t forget to check it out! And we have a lovely Halloween set coming to you when you make your way to the Item Mall, so watch out for it!

Elsword’s Spooky Graveyard Adventures!
A vengeful spirit is wreaking havoc and possessing monsters at the cemetery causing them to move differently and maybe say different things. Find out which monster is possessed and get awesome rewards!
For 10 minutes of accumulative log-in time, get 3 Rusty Cemetery Keys every day from Monday to Friday, 5 Rusty Cemetery Keys on the weekends (Saturday and Sunday), and 5 more on October 31st! You’ll be spending your days at the cemetery for the rest of October, that’s for sure!
We’ll also reward you with awesome treats for clearing the cemetery of its vengeful spirit! Clear it once and you’ll get 30 [Cobo] Pumpkin Flavored Candy, clear it twice for 30 [Cobo] Every Flavor Candy, and clear it 3 times for 30 [Cobo] Brightly Shinning Witch’s Amber!
You’ll also get Ghost’s Trace which you can collect and exchange for awesome things from Ariel!

Item Mall Goodies
You don’t have to look far for the best treat this Halloween because you’re it! This devilishly sweet design is enough to destroy your enemies with its sugar content alone (or so we hope!). Check out the Candy Devil Costume when it comes out!

https://i.imgur.com/bv5DnHb.jpg

If the costumes aren’t sweet enough for you (or the enemy) this little Candy Devil Pet will definitely make sure to knock out some teeth! Get your sweet new companion soon!

https://i.imgur.com/GyNuJsf.jpg

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Become the Shadow that Stalks in the Night, Show Off Your Skills, and Give Them a Fright!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/NztAneo.jpg

Heya adventurers! Fall is here and we all know that means, Halloween is just around the corner. Treats here we come! Also, we've got an awesome surprise brewing for you this week but we'll have to keep mum about it for the time being. However, make sure you're as lucky as a leprechaun! 

We’ve got TONS of forum activities for you this week, you might want to join them coz K-Ching will definitely rain down on the most creative players! And don’t forget to check out the Item Mall because we’ve got cool stuff waiting for you as well!

FORUM EVENTS
Elrios Pumpkin Decorating
How creative are you when working with pumpkins? If you think you’re the best, share your most creative Elsword Pumpkin design with us and you’ll be swimming in sweet K-Ching! Click here to view the event on our forums.

El Doodle – Halloween Edition
Who would you dress your character as this Halloween? Pick a favorite NPC, Boss, or monster and draw your beloved character dressed up as them! Characters with the most awesome costume gets a chance to win TONS of K-Ching, so start drawing! Click here to view the event on our forums.

ITEM MALL GOODIES
Reveal your demonic side and become a dark menace that frightens friends and foe alike. Exude an aura of intimidation with the Goatman set coming to you this week!

https://i.imgur.com/ZUaEIWx.jpg

So you’ve got the costume, but you might want to take it up a notch with a sit-motion that makes you look as regal and as powerful as you feel! Take a sit on the Goatman Demonic Throne!

https://i.imgur.com/kvPZvVB.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: We’ve Got Awesome Items for You Everyday and All You Have to do is Login!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/2PE7y67.jpg

Heya Adventurers! Get ready to fill your sacks with our daily giveaway coming this week! The best part of this giveaway is you only have to check your attendance after 20 mins of log-in! You heard that right, it’s a fuss-free attendance check event with awesome rewards and who can say no to that?! Not me, that’s fo sho! Plus, we’ve got something cool coming at the Item Mall so stay tuned to find out! 

Attendance Event
Don’t forget to announce your awesome presence via attendance check because you wouldn’t want to miss even just a day because of the rewards we have in-store!
Log-in to the game for an accumulative time of 20 minutes using the character you want to receive the reward. Simply wait for the exclamation mark to appear on the event icon located on top of your screen, click to open the UI and check the date of your attendance to receive a random reward listed at the rewards list!
We also have extra special rewards to those who manage to log-in for 3, 9, and 15 accumulative days! Hnnnggg! Rewards!

Item Mall Goodies
When evil becomes a fashion statement, you wouldn’t want to be an on-looker because the Evil Tracer 3 Ice Burner set brings something epic to the streets of Elrios! Complete the set!

https://i.imgur.com/WY5DB6l.jpg

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Let Peace and Prosperity Reign Over the Magical Lands of Elrios in the Harmony Festival!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/XpIFwMO.jpg

Heya adventurers! We’ve got a fun week ahead of us with revamps and awesome events! First up, we have a Character Balance Revamp to make your battles efficient and fair. You can test out your new skills tomorrow! Our beloved Profession System gets a major revamp with new achievements, new items, and a whole lot of new functions! You just might want to log-in and try it out for yourselves! Then we’re finally launching the new Mentor-Pupil System. Forge lasting friendships with one another while passing down a more experienced player’s knowledge to a new player! How awesome is that?! No more confused and directionless playing (unless that’s your style) again, totes awesome!

And finally, Harmony Festival is back! That’s right, get ready for awesome events, boosts, buffs, costumes, and more! It’s going to be one fantastic festival for sure! And don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for to check out new stuff and things!

Harmony Festival
A period of momentary peace has come to Elrios and with it brings lots of goodies and fun! 
Start hoarding Harmony Festival Pies because you can get it for FREE from Ariel!
Chat up Ariel to unlock special titles and use them during the event!
You also get to use a special skill and get additional Harmony Festival Buffs when you go dungeon running with the Heroes Assemble buff active!
Get Harmony Festival Costume Cubes when you login for 10 minutes once!  And get even more rewards when you log-in for 10 to 20 minutes daily!
Collect Harmony Festival Coins to exchange them with Ariel for useful consumables!
There’s also a very special place in Elrios to celebrate the Harmony Festival. Want to find out where it is? You can check it out tomorrow!

Item Mall Goodies
Make the ladies and gentlemen swoon when you sit down and play your tunes! Get the Eternal Vows Serenade Sit Motion in black and white tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/LdhdJyV.jpg

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in game~

notes.title: Looking for a Way to Contribute to Our Elsword Forum Community? Become a Mod!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/ceemHiO.jpg

Hiya adventurers! With the new forums running at full speed, we’re thinking we might need a little help from those of who are able and willing. That’s why for those not yet in the loop or if you just forgot, applications to become a full-pledged Forum Mod is open! If you or anyone you know has the qualifications, the heart, the humor, and the dedication to become a Mod, then you can submit your applications here. In other news, we also have the much-awaited wedding costume package at the Item Mall coming in tomorrow so stay tuned for this and more!

Item Mall Goodies
